publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper proposed the Microstrip Antenna which enhances the bandwidth with the use of Defected Ground Structure (DGS). The study and implementation of proposed antenna is discussed in this paper. With the use of DGS the bandwidth is increases efficiently to 6% as compared to the normal rectangular patch antenna. The proposed antenna is designed for Wi-Fi application at the resonant frequency of 2.4GHz. The H-shaped defected ground structure (DGS) displays the FR4 substrate characteristics with permeability `μ' and permittivity `ε'. The simulation is done by using High Frequency Structural Simulator (HFSS) version 13.0. Based on the simulation result the antenna indicates the improvement in term of return loss which is 36.77%. The Vector Network Analyzer is used for verification of performances of fabricated antenna such as return loss, VSWR and bandwidth.

articleTitle: Improvement of power quality of distribution system using ANN-LMBNN based D-STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In distribution system due to nonlinear loads causes voltage unbalancing lead to Power Quality (PQ) problems such as swell, sag and THD, to mitigate these PQ issues a Levenberg-Marquardt Back propagation (ANN-LMBNN) based D-STATCOM is proposed. The effectiveness of ANN based D-STATCOM is demonstrated on 13-bus distribution system by introducing D-STATCOM at node no-632. The efficacy of D-STATCOM with intelligent controller compared to D-STATCOM with PI controller.

articleTitle: Hydration reminding smart bottle: IoT experimentation
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper describes the experimentation architecture of Internet of Things (IoT) in real life. Objective of this work is to design water bottles which intimate a person to intake water on time to keep body temperature in stable. With busy schedules of humans and endless distractions, it's hard to remember to drink enough water by the humans. One of the health issues is not drinking sufficient amount of water properly in a human's daily life. Here the water float sensor can be used to sense the level of the water and it not only helps the users to measure the level of water, but also indicates the human to drink water when it's time to top up their body. This is a user-friendly project, that water bottle or flask can speaks with the person via passing commands as a message to drink sufficient water. The IoT experiment facility describes in this paper is conceived to provide a suitable platform for a large scale experimentation and evaluation of IoT concept under real life conditions.

articleTitle: A new series connected switched sources based multilevel inverter topology with reduced device count
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper introduces a new single phase multilevel inverter topology based on series connected switched sources. Here one basic module is developed. The proposed topology is comprised of series connection of the proposed basic module. It significantly reduces number of IGBTs, dc voltage sources, gate drivers used and increases number of levels. The mentioned topology has been synthesized for both symmetric and asymmetric source configurations. This work also introduces optimal structure of the mentioned topology based on different criterion. The advantage of this mentioned topology is shown in comparison with the conventional cascaded multilevel inverters and with some other proposed topologies in the literature. The validation of optimal structures is shown for a 63-level inverter and the validation of the proposed topology is ascertained by simulation using MATLAB and hardware embodiment of a single phase 15-level multilevel inverter.

articleTitle: Price area congestion management for an interconnected system with loop flows
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Due to the change in power generation technologies, power system models has changed from vertical utility structure to an open market structure where consumers are assured of good quality power at competitive prices. Major problem associated with this deregulated structure is network congestion. Congestion management is a mechanism to prioritize the transactions and reduce overload in the transmission lines. Different congestion management schemes has been introduced like nodal pricing, zonal pricing, generator rescheduling, price area congestion management, etc. Price area congestion management can be directly applied in case of a radial network where there is no loop flows. In this paper application of price area congestion management for an interconnected system with loop flows with the help of dc power flow calculations is discussed. A control algorithm is developed and is applied for a three area interconnected system to achieve this. The algorithm is tested on the three area system to relieve congestion. Application of price area concept along with dc power flow calculations make the process simple and can be applied for any interconnected network with n number of buses.

articleTitle: Nerve segmentation in ultrasound images
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Today medical field has provided us enormous facilities that has been never thought before. There has been done many improvements in the field of surgery, medicine, X-Rays and many more. But some areas still want some improvements so that patients don't need to face any type of difficulty or pain. This paper is trying to highlight the difficulties and in the treatments that are based on the ultrasound images. So in paper this our main focus is to improve the treatments based on ultrasound scans which is used widely in medical field due to vast area of application and cost effectiveness. These ultrasound scans are very important to detect any kind of injury of disease in human body because it used to scan the internal tissues of the body. One major disadvantage of these images is that they include huge amount of noise so doctors face difficulty in finding the exact location of the nerve where they have to inject the medicine to operate. These pictures are not clear enough to find the neve at once so they have to inject needle very times. With this application they can find the nerve very easily because it includes the segmentation of these nerves in ultrasound images. This application is further extended to train the system with this data so that it can be used worldwide.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling and energy management of a residential hybrid microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Residential microgrids are evolved from the prosumer concept. They are simply a home containing different generating sources, storage units and controllable loads. The optimal scheduling of a residential hybrid microgrid is an important aspect for improvised performance of the system and energy savings. The energy management strategy of a residential microgrid is responsible for setting the operating point of each and every component in the microgrid, such as the power delivered by the storage and the generating sources, the power used by loads and the power exchanged with the grid The objective function is formulated as to minimize the cost incurred by grid import by optimizing battery charging and discharging based on PV and load forecast. Linear programming technique is used for optimal scheduling of battery. A dual active bridge converter is used for bidirectional power flow for boosting up the dc bus voltage to a higher voltage for bidirectional inverter. A mode switching algorithm is used as an energy management strategy for exchanging the surplus and deficit power with main grid. Basic simulations are performed in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: ScrAnViz — A tool to scrap, analyze and visualize unstructured-data using attribute-based opinion mining algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Data visualization in big data analysis, facilitates decision makers to see analytics visually represented, that empowers them to understand difficult concepts or identify new patterns effortlessly. Existing visualization tools are capable of visualizing only structured data, but more than 80% of business information is in unstructured format. Hence there is a need for an end-to-end tool that could structure, summarize and visualize Unstructured-Data. With this notion, a flexible tool is being developed that could be applied to any domain accepting the domain-specific and user-specific attributes as inputs and plot graphs accordingly. The Unstructured-Data is obtained by web mining. Further, an effective attribute-based opinion mining algorithm has been proposed which enables the user to make well-informed decisions focusing on the attributes he is concerned most.

articleTitle: A review of multi-switch BLDC motor drive
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Permanent magnet BLDC motors are getting attention from research as well as the industry because of its excellent features like compact size, silent operation, high reliability and less maintenance requirements. Nowadays, PMBLDC motors are widely used in various applications instead of induction motor such as household, commercial and also in industrial area, also they can accepted for position control and medium sized industrial drives for different applications. Drive components are important for low cost and efficient system for industrial application of permanent magnet BLDC motors. It also includes cost effectiveness and efficiencies of these topologies. Comparative study of these different converter topologies of permanent magnet BLDC motor drive systems for industrial applications is described.

articleTitle: Synchronverter based HVDC transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This is an innovative control strategy for the High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission based on synchronverter technology. The control of sending end rectifier mimics a synchronous motor(SM) and the receiving end inverter controls acts as a synchronous generator (SG). The combination of these rectifier and inverter along with a DC link is called synchronverter HVDC (SHVDC). A frequency droop control and voltage regulation methods are important to explain the SHVDC technology. In this paper, HVDC transmission based on conventional vector control method is compared with HVDC transmission based on this new synchronverter technology.

articleTitle: Study of control techniques for torque ripple reduction in BLDC motor
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The smooth operation of varying speed drives is primary consideration regarding parameters such as Motor speed, Torque, variation of flux or electromagnetic back emf to obtained maximum efficiency. Under ideal condition, torque produced in BLDC motor with trapezoidal back emf is constant, But in practical cases, some pulsating torque is produced in motor due to motor manufacturing structure, designing factures such as slot, teeth etc. and one of main reason because of control strategies. Here, ideas related to reduction of torque ripples is done through motor structure and from control of driving parts of motor. This Paper reviews on torque pulsation relates with control side of BLDC motor. Therefore varieties of control techniques for different drive configuration are discussed.

articleTitle: Automatic detection of drowsiness in EEG records based on time analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Driver drowsiness has been identified as a root cause of more than 20% of crashes resulting in injuries and deaths globally. Drowsiness leads to deterioration in driver's performance and vehicle-handling abilities. This research aims at using time analysis techniques to automatically detect the level of drowsiness in EEG records. Noise from the EEG signals were removed by subjecting it to band-pass filtering with cut-off frequency 0.5 Hz to 60 Hz and then segmented into 5 second intervals. 1 EEG channel was used to compute 3 features s to differentiate the awareness and drowsiness stages. This method gets up to 85.7% of alertness and drowsiness correct detections rates. Both the stages can be distinguished based on the parameters and acquired results. Real time outputs can be obtained making it easily accessible. An automatic drowsiness detection system in vehicles can be employed using these parameters thereby decreasing the risk posed by drowsy driving. The algorithm developed here has been tested on samples obtained from The MIT-BIH Polysonographic Database on physionet.org.

articleTitle: Power quality improvement of grid using solar photovoltaic farm
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: PV solar inverter plays essential role for generating the electricity at distributed end. A large scale PV generation includes photovoltaic array, DC/AC converters and related controllers. Proposed research work is about the grid voltage regulation in the PV solar farm. Solar farm inverter can be act as a STATCOM during night time when the solar farm is inactive. It avoids the other voltage compensating devices. Moreover when two or more PV Solar farms connected with the same distribution line in parallel mode, there is better voltage regulation achieved by operating all the solar farms as a STATCOM. A MATLAB/Simulink based simulation study is presented to validate the performance of proposed work.

articleTitle: Investigations on performance evaluation of VFD fed PMSM using DTC control strategies for pumping applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive study of various control strategies on PMSM fed with the centrifugal pump like conventional DTC, DTC with Space Vector Modulation. The mentioned strategies are analysed and reviewed for centrifugal pump and various performance parameters of both motor as well as pump are evaluated and compared through matlab simulation. To pick the best among control strategies, comparison has been done at different frequencies. Various motor control parameters analysed are electromagnetic torque, stator current, rotor speed, stator flux etc., and pump parameters like flow rate and pressure are evaluated.

articleTitle: Multiport interleaved converter for DC microgrid applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Multiport DC-DC converters help in efficiently managing power and integrating load with multiple sources. An isolated converter is preferred for applications which require galvanic isolation between energy sources, battery system and the load. An isolated multiport interleaved converter which is used for integrating a solar PV source and a battery energy storage system with a dc load is proposed in this paper. The proposed converter operation has been affirmed through MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Efficient WMaxMin static algorithm for load balancing in cloud computation
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cloud Computing is the new emerging area which provides variety of deployment as well as service model such as SAAS, PAAS and IAAS and it is in rapid adoption by many vendors and companies which are growing in the fast rate. Most critical functionality in Cloud Computation is Load balancing because the data centers have n number of hosts and these host comprises of n number of virtual machines, so when tasks (cloudlets) comes it must be assigned to the virtual machines without overloaded and under loaded any of the VMs. There are many algorithms for load balancing in cloud but still the problem persists. Here the idea is to combine the Weighted Round Robin and Max Min algorithm to implement an efficient load balancing algorithm which is WeightedMaxMin by taking two consideration factors viz., waiting time and Response time. The simulation and implementation is through CloudSim.

articleTitle: One switched-inductor Z-source inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The novel topology of one switched-inductor (SL) Z-source inverter is presented in this paper. The presented one SL-ZSI provides high boost factor when compare to conventional ZSI with the addition of one extra inductor and three diodes. The components used in the proposed topology are higher than the traditional ZSI and lower than the SL-ZSI. The analysis, derivation of boost factor, capacitor voltages, diode voltages, and switch stress of the proposed inverter topology are carried out and are compared with the conventional ZSI, SL-ZSI. To validate the theoretical analysis, the simulation is carried out with the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: A system for application deployment automation on cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Totally automated provisioning and application of applications are one of the most crucial basics to work with the benefits associated with cloud computing are reducing costs for managing and maintaining the application. A lot of techniques, tools, and provider are available to automate the deployment methods. The DevOps society offers tooling to implement deployment software in an application-oriented manner. Every project has different types of environment such as Development, Production, Quality Analysis and Demo. It is also designed on a multitier architecture such as Web node, Application node, and Database node. System operation team faces challenges for managing and deploying the applications on all environments and it too much time for deploying the application on multiple servers. As the number of code changes in a project, then the cost for deploy of the project must be pay to developers and operational personnel. In this paper, a web-based application which focuses on installation and configuration of any software on the cloud base server.

articleTitle: A review on single switch Dc-Dc converter for renewable energy based applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The renewable energy as input needs a boost voltage to balance the utility grid and so the conversion of boost up voltage process is required. The DC-DC converters play a major role in high voltage gain and efficiency in the renewable energy conversion system. It's very important to maintain the system efficiency. The voltage stress is reduced by the reduction in the semiconductor devices. Hence single switch DC-DC converter plays a major role in maintaining efficiency and voltage stress which increases the voltage transmission ratio.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of delay and throughput using IEEE 802.11 and receiver centric-MAC protocol in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network is a collection of sensor nodes, which are used for sending and receiving data packets from one sensor node to another sensor node. Wireless sensor networks have wide range of applications in various fields like agriculture, military, medical and health care. Data can be transmitting through different sensor nodes to the receiver's node. In this research work considering parameters throughput, end to end delay and packet delivery ratio, these are the main quality of services for wireless sensor networks. In this novel approach comparing the parametric measures like throughput, end to end delay and packet delivery ratio with existing MAC IEEE 802.11 protocol and novel approach RC-MAC protocol. This research work is implemented by using NS 2.35 simulator. Results show that performance of RC-MAC is better than MAC IEEE 802.11, 94.08% of less delay, more packet delivery ratio and throughput improved by 2.4 % compared with MAC IEEE 802.11.

articleTitle: Design of photovoltaic based battery charger using sliding mode MPPT control
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A Photovoltaic PV module along with an interconnection which gives proper voltage and current to charge rechargeable batteries is termed as PV Battery Charger. The interconnection system used is DC-DC converter which provides suitable charging voltage and current to the battery. Maximum Power Point Tracking is very unique to the field of PV systems to extract maximum power during operation. There are many conventional methods available for Maximum power point tracking but they fail under rapidly varying weather conditions. To overcome this problem, non linear controllers are utilized much in the field of photovoltaic system. In this paper, the Sliding Mode Controller is implemented as the MPPT algorithm to deliver maximum power even under rapidly varying environmental conditions, disturbances and system uncertainties. The obtained results indicate that the Sliding Mode Controller provides robustness under varying weather conditions compared to the conventional MPPT algorithms.

articleTitle: Energy harvesting through acoustic field for powering low power electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: An acoustic energy harvesting system has been proposed and investigated. The designed acoustic energy harvester comprises a grated rectangular metal slit with a metal screen and a piezoelectric component placed at the bottom of the screen. The strong acoustic field stimulates the metal screen as well as piezoelectric component mechanically converting the acoustic energy into electric energy. It is found that the grated harvester model with piezoelectric component is more efficient than a non grating structure. It is observed that the total output electric potential depends on the shape, size, material of the piezoelectric component as well as medium. The theoretical simulation has been carried out in order to obtain an appropriate elucidation for practical design of an efficient energy harvesting system through acoustic grating structure. The harvested energy can be utilized for powering low power electronic devices.

articleTitle: A hybrid fuel cell-supercapacitor system employing adaptive control to overcome fuel starvation phenomenon of fuel cell
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Increase in research orientation in the field of structure and control of microgrids play a major role in seamless inclusion of clean energy into microgrids to suffice the conventional energy requirements. This paper presents a low voltage DC microgrid incorporating fuel cell based reliable clean energy generation and supercapacitor based transient energy storage device to form a stiff DC source for the local DC loads. Fuel cell stack and supercapacitor bank are interfaced to load terminals using a DC-DC boost converter and DC-DC bidirectional converter respectively. Dual loop control is used to establish control for these power electronic interfaces in order to facilitate stable power to the load irrespective of the constrained operating characteristics of the fuel cell and transient load variations. Proper power sharing, safe operation of the equipment and optimal control of state variables is achieved by employing the current control. A special case of SOC protection of supercapacitor is dealt in this paper. The proposed system along with the controller is tested for different transient R, R-L loads operating in an intermittent mode using MATLAB/SIMULINK modelling. The aftermath of the associated control action is a stabilized grid voltage (48V) with required power flow among microgrid participants in order to suffice the transient power requirements of the grid loads even after respecting the operating constraints associated with the microgrid participants.

articleTitle: Smart energy management and control of stand-alone pico-hydro systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Stand-alone systems are the only viable option for electrification of rural and remote locations. This paper presents design and development of a cost effective, efficient, smart energy management system for the control of three-phase self-excited induction generator (SEIG) suitable for stand-alone pico-hydro power generation with constant input power. The objective is to improve the utilization efficiency of the pico-hydro system in real time while maintaining voltage regulation and load management of the micro-grid system.

articleTitle: Braille display by rotating multi-octagonal segment
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Braille display is a device from which the visually challenged people can tactually read the text output from the computer in the form of Braille character. Braille has more advantages over synthetic speech because Braille has an important role in enhancing education, employment and income. But the commercially available Braille display price is in the range of R 100000 to R 500000 so it can't be easily avail for poor visually challenged people. So, this paper discusses about the making of new type of Braille display, by rotating multi-octagonal segments, with low cost. Here the text is converted into Braille character by rotating each octagonal segment, which contains all possible combination of raised dots of one column of Braille cell on its faces, to a particular degree. The required Braille character appears on the top face of the octagonal segments. This paper further discusses about the mechanical design of new Braille display, converting text into corresponding degree of rotation by using MATLAB, transferring that estimated degree to Arduino board and controlling the stepper motors to achieve the correct output (Braille characters).

articleTitle: Multi area load frequency control of power system involving renewable and non-renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Due to the increase in population and industrial growth, the need for power generation also increases. But generation of power using conventional sources is not at all sufficient to meet the increased load demand. So generation of power using renewable sources like Wind, Hydro, Solar and biogas … etc. is also going on increasing. But generation of power by these sources cannot be controlled unlike thermal power plants. The irregular nature of these sources increases the frequency deviations caused by load variation. Therefore, in this paper Load frequency control (LFC) including PI, PID and Fuzzy Controllers is proposed in order to minimize frequency deviations, tie line power interchange and to ensure steady state errors to be zero involving renewable and non-renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Wind turbine emulator for a microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Throughout the past few years, power generation based on wind energy has become a considerable aspect in the present power generation. This has caused an increase in the wind power based research and in this project a wind turbine emulator is developed to simulate wind turbine behavior with a connection to a micro grid in a laboratory environment. Wind turbine characteristics are modelled using a separately excited DC motor for both steady and transient states. DC motor is coupled with a synchronous generator to provide the power output.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of an energy efficient LED based lighting scheme for a pharmaceutical industry
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Artificial lighting is one of the visible source of energy consumption in any industries. Energy consumption can be minimized by providing an energy efficient lighting strategy. For achieving energy efficiency in lighting, compromise with lighting requirement in illumination levels is not entertained. Hence the lighting strategy must be suggested such that the required illumination levels are maintained by employing low power consuming lighting fixtures. This paper presents the results economic analysis of a lighting audit done on a pharmaceutical industry located at Chennai, India and proposes an energy efficient lighting solution to cope up with the short comings. In this study, economic analysis is carried out in terms of Payback. An initial survey of the site is carried out to acquire lighting details of the pharmaceutical industry. Existing lighting system, illumination levels and patterns, different areas and their functionalities etc. are studied. The existing lighting system is simulated in the lighting simulation software DIALux. Based on the results of lighting audit and simulation of existing system, a new LED based lighting strategy is suggested in order to maintain the required illumination level and minimize the energy consumption of the lighting system of the building. Energy efficient lighting solutions not only reduces the energy consumption but also helps in reducing the carbon footprint.

articleTitle: A novel strategy for three phase grid connected pulse width modulated VSI
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Reactive power management in a power network is one of the most stochastic process involved in grid power management system. Change in reactive power management sometimes changes the voltage at the point of common coupling of renewable sources with that of the grid. Variation at the terminal voltage also affects the power factor thereby decreasing the efficiency and increasing the losses in the distribution as well as in the inverter. Most of the inverter uses voltage source inverter topology to interconnect the renewable sources to the grid and thereby maintaining the grid synchronization and stability. This paper utilizes the concept of hysteresis controller to control the active and reactive power independently for a Pulse Width Modulation based grid connected inverter. Adaptive hysteresis controller adopted in this paper reduces both the current harmonic and hence decreases the total harmonic distortion (THD). Performance of the controller may be judged from steady and transient condition of operation of the controller. Validity of the controller has been verified through Matlab Simulink modelling.

articleTitle: Solar block: Thermal capacity enhancement of concrete bricks using water and candle wax for passive indoor thermal comfort
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Concrete has replaced traditional building materials and has found acceptance even in the cold climatic regions of India and the world, despite its poor insulating property. An experiment was designed to check if the thermal energy storage capacity of concrete blocks could be enhanced. This was done by using water and candle wax (as PCM) filled in plastic bottles embedded in 1 cubic foot (0.0283 cubic metre) concrete blocks. Four blocks of different concrete mixture ratios were made. Each block had 9 plastic bottles embedded within; with three of them having just water and the fourth one having a combination of water and candle wax as the heat storage material. The blocks (Solar Blocks) were tested during the summer of Ladakh. The report analysed two sets of data of temperatures recorded with a month's gap, including one on a rainy day. Temperatures above 40° C were recorded in the blocks and a temperature of above 20° C was maintained despite a complete cloudy and rainy day with cool winds in all the blocks. However, no exceptional enhancement in the storage capacity was noticed in the fourth block having the combination of water and candle wax as the storage material.

articleTitle: Modeling and control of level control process — A comparative study
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Tank level control systems are everywhere. All of our process industries mostly depends on this tank level control systems. This paper deals with the modeling and control of a two tank liquid level control system. The considered non linear system is a Single Input Single Output (SISO) system. The goal of the level control is to track the desired level of liquid in to the second tank by controlling the flow rate of the first tank. The tanks are coupled in the interacting and non-interacting ways and a comparison is made between these two systems. The mathematical modeling is done by mass balance method and the PID controller is designed by the trial and error method. The system is simulated with both open loop and closed loop conditions. A comparative study of the time domain response of the two systems while using the PID controller is done by the MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of scientific workflow scheduling in cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cloud platform is the model of parallel and distributed computing. It offers the facilities by pay-as per-usage policy. Also provides the platform for high performance application like scientific applications. Virtualization, elasticity and pay by use are the important features of cloud computing. It allows the user to submit their tasks by providing varieties of resources through internet. Since cloud provides the facility of running multiple tasks simultaneously, an eminent scheduling algorithm is needed for the better performance. Numerous task based schedulers are available in the cloud environment. In this paper we have done the analysis of various traditional scheduling algorithms based on the parameters like average makespan and cost.

articleTitle: Colliding bodies optimization applied on IEEE-57 bus system for optimal power flow problem
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A newly explored heuristic optimization technique named as Colliding Bodies Optimization (CBO) technique is presented to optimize three different objectives on IEEE-57 bus system in optimal power flow framework of a power system network. CBO is a natural functioning of one dimensional collision between two quantities based on the traditional phenomenon. The advantage of being CBO is the modest in construction and need not to be tune of any control parameters. CBO is demonstrated on IEEE-57 bus system with different objective functions such as the minimization of total production cost, minimization of total voltage deviation, minimization of L-index. In order to observe the feasibility and effectiveness, the CBO algorithm is compared with the existing methods available in the literature. The observation shows the CBO technique provided the qualitative optimal solutions for considered objective functions of OPF problem.

articleTitle: An analysis of cost efficiency on home appliances using smart power distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents the empirical analysis on reducing the electricity bill of residential consumers by smart distribution of power. The paper proposes the necessity of smart way of scheduling the residential loads with Time of Tariff (ToT) system along with roof-top solar energy system. The consumers can also act as power producer and they can sell. Nearby consumers are allowed to purchase the produced power from neighbors at the rate of lower cost on comparing with electricity board (EB). Obviously this paper describes these concepts and develops the model in MATLAB/Simulink with three residential buildings. The load curves of three buildings are plotted using simulation and variation of annual cost of each building is evaluated.

articleTitle: Disease prediction using optimal feature selection from epigenetic data
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Epigenetic changes are identified to correlate with gene expression changes among numerous diseases including cancer. Although integrated data analysis tools are available, a quantitative model that precisely predicts the diseases from epigenetic information is still in its infancy. In this paper, a data mining approach is presented for predicting a disease using the most relevant genes (treated as features) associated with it. A few existing feature selection methods have been applied independently and their results combined to form a fused feature set. For selecting the optimal set of genes from them, a genetic algorithm based evolutionary approach is proposed. They have been applied to a classifier for recognizing the disease from a set of reference samples. A key observation from our analysis is that the optimization using genetic algorithm gives better prediction accuracy than the existing methods. Hence the proposed optimal fusion based feature selection can be effectively applied for better disease diagnosis and prognosis.

articleTitle: Loss reduction & reactive power support in Rajasthan power system: A case study
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents case study of real time system operation to reduce losses with optimum utilization of existing transmission system elements. West-North part of Rajasthan power system having one 400 kV GSS, five 220 kV GSS and nineteen 132 kV GSS have been selected to carry out case study and simulated in PSSE software. Simulation model consists of 55 buses, 34 transmission lines, 66 transformers and 34 capacitor banks. Total system load is 594.95 MW & 325.56 MVAR. Eight cases have been simulated considering the effect of transformer tap position, closing of opened transmission lines and shunt capacitors. From simulation studies it is found out that transmission losses are reduced by 50.36 % in addition to improve network voltage profile and reduce loading.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of conventional and modified peak-detection based control technique for cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter based shunt active power filter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a modified peak-detection algorithm based control theory for three-phase, three-wire (3P-3W) Shunt Active Power Filter (SAPF) where Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter (CHB-MLI) is used as a voltage source inverter (VSI) unit for reactive power compensation, power factor correction and harmonic mitigation in mediumvoltage and high-power distribution system. The proposed control theory is implemented in MATLAB/Simulink platform and a rigorous comparative analysis is done with well known p-q theory and synchronous reference frame (SRF) theory to prove its effectiveness. Comparative study shows that modified control algorithm gives better transient performance in terms of settling time and peak overshoot.

articleTitle: Multi key distribution scheme by diophantine form for secure IoT communications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: IoT devices are everywhere. Shortly, every “thing” is going to be connected and interact with each other. What are these things? They can be your microwaves, heaters, air conditioners or even your refrigerators. It assessed that there would be 50 billion connected IoT devices by 2020 which is about 7 IoT gadgets for every individual on the planet. IoT devices are low powered devices which have a minimal amount of processing capabilities. With ever increasing number of IoT devices, there is a subsequent need for secure communication among them. In this paper, we aim to propose an encryption algorithm used for secure communication by taking into account the limitations of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Optimal sizing of a hybrid PV, wind and micro-hydro system for rural electrification using LPO
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to optimize the cost of electricity (CE) and minimizing the output power variance in order to get more reliable system and increased system efficiency. In this paper, a mathematical model of solar, wind and micro-hydro power plant were proposed and connected together in order to build an economic system and sufficient to supply the load. The optimization problem was solved by using Linear Programming Optimization (LPO) technique within the system constraints with the help of special function linprog of Matlab2014a. The results show that the LPO is reliable, efficient, robust, fast and capable of solving optimization problems.

articleTitle: Detection of bad data in phasor measurement units using distributed approach
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The chances for presence of bad data in Phasor measurement units are increasing due to complicated power system. Thus the voltage magnitude and phase angle obtained from PMU is no longer accurate. Hence it is important to detect the presence of bad data and identify the PMU which contains the error. In order to implement bad data detection and identification, state estimation is carried out to obtain the true state variables using weighted least square method. In this paper a distributed approach is chosen for identification of bad data. The system network is divided into different areas and the technique is applied to each area separately. The area and the meter which contains error is identified through this method. The system works in MATLAB platform.

articleTitle: Energy efficient heterogeneous network with daily load variation
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper considers a heterogeneous network consisting of Massive Multiple Input Multiple Output deployed at Macro Base Station (MBS) overlaid with small cells. Soft cell coordination is implemented with Daily load variation for optimisation of total power consumption in the system. The daily load profile records the load variation at different hours of the day. The number of active base station antennas varies with the load and the inactive antennas are put in Sleep mode. The simulation results show significant reduction in total power consumption by the proposed method as compared to implementation of only Soft cell coordination.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of bipole HVDC transmission system installed by a tapping station
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Generally electric power/energy can be transmitted through either by HVAC or HVDC. Compared to HVAC, HVDC system has number of advantages. The reliability of HVDC system depending upon the reliability of each component in it. When the load demand exceeds the generating capacity, a small generating station or tapping station is installed on the line to meet the load demand. But the demand varies with respect to the load. In such a case tapping station capacity will affect the reliability indices of the system. In this paper the effect of tapping station capacity on reliability indices is discussed and optimal capacity level of tapping station is identified.

articleTitle: Multilevel queue scheduling in software defined networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: One of the highly reliable protocol stack used in communication networking industry is TCP/IP Protocol suite. Due to the huge support from the customers communication sector grows tremendously, leading to many contributions from the academicians and industrialist. The protocol stack needs to be optimized in order to meet the dynamic changes. The changes must be adopted dynamically from the administration point of view. Since the increase in usage of the communication network increases the traffic rate, network management and control becomes more challenging. Hence the upcoming technology, Software Defined Networking addresses a methodology of handling the above mentioned issues in a simple manner by separating control and data plane at network layer. This article aims to provide scheduling algorithm for handling the incoming data traffic in an effective manner. The simulation is carried using OMNeT++ and results depicts that the proposed method shows a significant reduction in the packet loss.

articleTitle: System modelling and simulation of interconnected wind — PV standalone
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This manuscript presents the modelling of solar photovoltaic and wind driven permanent magnet generator systems implementing maximum power tracking algorithms using a buck-boost converter. Hill-climbing search algorithm is implemented to extract maximum power from wind turbine system and incremental conductance for a PV system. An effort to interconnect two renewable sources is proposed and implemented as a standalone in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The wind energy and PV systems are interconnected through dc-dc converters feeding an ac load through sine pulse width modulated inverter.

articleTitle: Low cost and processor efficient facial recognition system
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The objective of this research project is to develop a system with a webcam and efficiently detect faces of persons preciously loaded in the database. This project aims towards the use of facial recognition using mundane processors and hence the system is optimized and reviews the grand challenges that are faced for developing such a system and a literary survey that has provided a crucial insight in the developing of the system. Viola Jones Algorithm has been utilized to detect a face within a picture and ECOC for training to fit multi class models into categories or code-words. With the algorithm and the code as suggested in this paper, results are projected towards various lighting conditions of front profile of faces. Under normal lighting conditions a very high detection rate of has been obtained. Under partial exposure a lower detection rate has been obtained and at overexposed conditions detection rate similar to normal lighting conditions has been obtained. The rejection rate is however, cent percent in all three conditions mentioned. There is ample scope for implementing recognition techniques.

articleTitle: Integrated single stage standalone solar PV inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The proposed Integrated Single Stage Standalone Solar PV Inverter (IS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> PVI), converts the output from the PV panel directly to AC, while maintaining the output voltage constant. The efficiency of the inverter is improved by minimizing the voltage drop across the inductor. The switching loss in this circuit is minimized by operating one power switch in high frequency. Optimization tool is used to find the suitable inductance value in the power circuit with minimum voltage drop and higher efficiency. A hardware setup for 220V, 50Hz, 700W solar inverter is arranged using 1KW solar system and 100Ah, 12V battery to generate 50Hz sinusoidal voltage with constant magnitude

articleTitle: Biometric based subregion analysis for handwritten signature
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Subregions of signature area lead to the off-line signature analysis. It is observed in certain subregions of signature, the variation persists in different signing instances. By manual verification system, an acceptable level of variation can be noticed. The incipient applications for authentication require simple robust methods to provide ideal substantiation. There exists natural variation in definite fragments of the signature provided by genuine subject at different intervals. Ignoring natural variation will dissipate the processing time in imposter samples. The design of verification system should consider all categories of forgeries. The selected list of quadtree components regulates the subregions. The proposed research work accomplish off-line signature verification with the classification techniques based on zero-plot of the inverse slope, contour tracing using intersection points and Gaussian-Hermite moment. The best results were achieved for method based on zero-plot of the inverse slope with false rejection rate (FRR) 4% and false acceptance rate (FAR) 5%.

articleTitle: Data Science Vis-à-Vis efficient healthcare and medical systems: A techno-managerial perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A large number of structured or unstructured data is the core of big data which organizations and institutions have the potentially for the analysis of business as well as other requirements. In big data platform data or information basically comes from different sources and importantly collected outcome of scientific experiments is used in the internet of things. In Big Data systems, Data may be treated as a source of intelligent systems mechanism by the use of separate software tools before analytics. It is an important fact that technology is rising everyday e.g. social media, in which the creation of information is just takes few seconds from the users. Data Science program is another terminology for Big Data. The Data Science is also referred as Business Analytics or simply Analytics domain. There are several applications of Big Data found in different sectors which include the Healthcare, Banking and Finance, Information Foundations as well as Corporate sectors. There is currently a shortage of data scientists and other analysts who have experience working with big data. Medical service is an emerging area in which applications of cloud based service are highly noticed in these days. Moreover analyzing in Big Data Management System helps in managing information in multiple scales in Health Care Service that include a particular disease to detailed of DNA, proteins and metabolites to cells, tissues, organs, organisms and ecosystems. This is a conceptual and also a kind of policy paper in which several in general aspects of big data with focused on medical systems have been illustrated. Paper is also explores potentialities of creating manpower for medical informatics or similar professionals having adequate knowledge of big data and analytics technologies.

articleTitle: A multi objective control technique for interfacing hybrid renewable energy sources in an islanded microgrid subsequent to unbalanced and non linear load conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The paper demonstrates a control technique for medium voltage islanded microgrid to integrate hybrid renewable energy source (RES) units into the microgrid system while maintaining active power balancing among the RES units and to control interfaced power electronics converters under unbalanced and non linear load conditions. The control strategy aims to eliminate the risk associated with voltage fluctuations and to maintain power balance in order to maintain better power quality under unbalanced and nonlinear load conditions. The operation of the micrigrid is examined by connecting hybrid RES units to the load through a multilevel inverter. The control scheme consists of a multi loop control solution for the CHB multilevel inverter employing multi proportional resonant converters and a energy management section for hybrid RES units. The hybrid RES units employ fuel cell(FC) and photovoltaic (PV) sources as the prime energy sources while supercapacitor (SC) is considered as the complementary energy source. The multi-PR controller helps to tune the bus voltages even during unbalanced conditions and non linear load conditions. The proposed control scheme has been validated through MATLAB/Simulink based simulation model for varying load demands.

articleTitle: Reduction of inrush current using point on wave switching in power transformers
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to mitigate the inrush current by using Point On Wave (POW) switching technique. The proposed technique is used to limit the inrush current while energizing the transformer. An algorithm is developed using EMTP/PSCAD software and the prototype with the proposed algorithm is built in the laboratory. It is tested by using DSP TMS320F28069 controller. The simulation and hardware results are presented to validate the capability of the proposed system.

articleTitle: MTE: Modular traffic engineering in software-defined data center networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In recent years, several methods have been presented for optimized use of resources in cloud datacenters networks, which are mainly based on fat-tree connections. In this paper, a new algorithm for traffic engineering (TE) in a modular mode is presented. In the proposed algorithm, the less loaded paths for conduction of current are selected with regard to the present conditions as soon as a current is generated between two hosts, their position is identified in the data center network, and the paths between the two are obtained. Results achieved from Mininet emulator indicate that performance of Modular Traffic Engineering (MTE) method is on average 70% better than the algorithm dominantly applied in equal-cost multipath routing (ECMP) datacenters. Although the time during which data is read from OpenFlow switches imposes overflow on the system, such overflows are of insignificant impacts on performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Power management in microgrid using PI controller tuned by particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper a control technique for power management in a utility connected microgrid is discussed. The objective is to control the real and reactive power flow between the main grid and the microgrid. Sharing power amid microgrid and grid at the desired ratio is the important parameter. The control technique is designed for real power and reactive power management. The proposed strategy is such that the micro grid and utility share the load power. When the power requirement is greater than the power from DG units, then the utility will supply the deficit power, and when the power demand is less than power from the DG unit the extra power will be injected into the utility. The result of the control technique provides good response.

articleTitle: A Bip2arametric variation (Tt-Tg) degrades the performance of TDF-IMC scheme for load frequency control
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Sensitivity of the two-degrees of freedom based IMC controller to variation in power plant parameters is studied. Here, we adopted the reduced order model of the plant as the predictive model for the controller design. Selection of tuning parameter is critical and relates to the transient behavior of the steam power plant. Parametric study shows that the frequency regulation of the plant is highly affected by a biparametric variation in turbine and governor time constants (Tt-Tg); regardless of the variation in other plant parameters. Thus signifying the inherent limitations of the scheme used for load frequency control of the plant. Results suggest that avoiding biparametric variation can still enable smooth functioning of the degraded plant.

Author Keywords: Two degrees of freedom IMC or TDF-IMC

articleTitle: BESM based approach to build energy efficient smart homes
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The Internet of Things is a growing technology which makes use of smart objects where connection and communication between the smart objects took place. IoT is used in many application areas like entertainment, medical, transport, agriculture, security, E-health, etc. even though there are many issues in IoT, one of the main issues during recent years is power management. The need for power management in smart homes focuses on reducing electricity cost and avoiding the high peak demand problems. For reducing electricity cost, another source of power can be used. The most preferable primary power unit will be solar power due to its availability in nature. This paper prioritizes the operation of power units. The proposed system consists of a controller, a photovoltaic system with battery, smart electrical appliance and smart communication network. The main use of the controller is to schedule the power units which may be solar power, battery power and grid supply. The proposed system uses Battery Energy Storage and Management (BESM) algorithm, which helped to reduce electricity cost. The smart controller works on BESM algorithm which picks up power units according to demand. There will be energy conversion from DC to AC so to improve quality of power, Selective Harmonic Elimination(SHE) method. This paper focuses on end user's income level and also the users' difficulty in managing power usage with time varying prices. The proposed system will consider environmental factors like room temperature, outside temperature and user habits like appliance usage frequency, appliance usage characteristics.

articleTitle: Closed loop speed controlled two stage PFC converter fed PMSM drive
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents the closed loop controlled two stage PFC (Power Factor Correction) converter fed PMSM (Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor) drive. The proposed PFC converters consist of uncontrolled rectifier, PFC converter and DC converter. The π filter is connected at the output of converter to reduce output ripple of DC converter. The performance of the proposed converter is verified by interfacing inverter and PMSM drive. This work deals with comparison of PI & FL controlled two stage PFC converter fed PMSM drive system. The steady state performance parameters like output voltage ripple, speed, power factor, THD are analyzed with PI (Proportional Integrative) and Fuzzy Logic Controller(FLC). The Transient parameters such as rise time, peak time, settling time, and steady state error also compared for both controller. The Closed loop PI & FL controlled two stage PFC converter Fed PMSM drive systems are modeled and simulated.

articleTitle: Electrical characterization of XLPE cable using accelerated water absorption test on medium voltage power cable and partial discharge test on power cable with termination defects
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: XLPE cables have high dielectric strength and excellent ageing characteristics in dry environment. But a problem that appears, especially in case of underground cable, is the effect of water absorption on the insulation of the cable. Hence this papers firstly aims at presenting the results of variation of Capacitance, Dissipation Factor, Stability Factor and Relative Permittivity, with respect to water absorption. Partial discharge is an important parameter measured as a part of routine test for the power cables in all the cable manufacturing industries. Hence the paper secondly aims at creating the termination defects, purposely, on the newly manufactured cable and analyze the variation in the value of partial discharge by performing partial discharge test on this cable. The increase in the value of electric field stress at the defects is analyzed by simulation using FEMM Software.

articleTitle: Spectrum handoff scheme in cognitive radio network using multiple attribute decision making and artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: There has been a big spike in the usage of wireless devices since the time wireless devices came into existence. This has paved way for a serious problem of spectrum scarcity. The solution to this problem comes in the form of cognitive radio networks where a secondary or an unlicensed user, opportunistically uses the spectrum when the primary or the licensed user is not using it and vacates and moves to another frequency when the primary user appears or when the primary user faces interference above a threshold level. This change from one frequency channel to another by the secondary user is called spectrum handoff. In this paper, we propose a spectrum handoff scheme which makes use of Multiple Attribute Decision Making (MADM) and is further extended to be used with Artificial Neural Networks (ANN).

articleTitle: An economical analysis of charging electric three wheelers using solar biogas hybrid energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electric three wheelers are used extensively in most of the districts of Bangladesh for transportation. Despite the apparent advantages these vehicles are consuming a huge amount of energy. To provide this increasing number of energy for a developing country like Bangladesh is very difficult when it is already facing severe power crisis. Our thesis deals with the hybrid energy system to provide this required energy to charge electric three wheelers. In this paper the overall cost analysis of the hybrid system and simulations using Homer software are included. A district named Naogaon, Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh (24°32' and 25°13' north latitudes and in between 88°23' and 89°10' east longitudes) has been taken as the contextual investigate. [10] The proposed hybrid system consists of solar and biomass energy. This investigation highlights the future advancements which can possibly expand the financial allure of such frameworks and it will reduce the power crisis of Bangladesh.

articleTitle: A grid integrated wind energy conversion system with fuzzy based maximum power extraction for plug-in electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper introduces a smart control system which automatically detects the amount of power transfer from the Renewable Energy sources to an Electric vehicle and optimizes the power flow. When there is fully charged condition of the vehicle battery the power is transferred from the Renewable Energy sources to the Power grid. During absence of Wind, the Wind Energy conversion System would be inactive. In such a scenario the Grid would act as the source for the Electric vehicle to be charged. During conditions when the wind energy is present but is in a fluctuating quantity, the energy from Wind energy Conversion System and the Grid is optimized for adequate transfer to the Electric Vehicle. The scheme also aims at maximizing the power capturing capacity from the Renewable energy sources and hence a novel Fuzzy Based Pitch angle Control mechanism is incorporated which also enables Maximum Power Point tracking mechanism. The Active power flow is controlled suitably to optimize the vehicle battery discharging.

articleTitle: Hadamard based SLM using genetic algorithm fo PAPR reduction in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the recent years there is a drastic improvement in the communication systems. The discovery of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing technique (OFDM) plays a major role in the high data rate communication system. However, the main drawback of OFDM systems is high Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR). Many of the existing PAPR reduction methods have drawbacks such as high complexity, increased Bit Error Rate (BER) and excess redundant information. Recently, precoding techniques has been investigated for PAPR reduction. Due to its low complexity and reduced cost of implementation this technique is an attractive emerging method that yields a substantial reduction of PAPR. In this paper, a novel precoding based on Hadamard Selected Mapping (HSLM) method and genetic algorithm (GA) has been proposed for PAPR reduction in OFDM systems.

articleTitle: Power divider with substrate integrated waveguide and CSRR for C band application
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A Miniaturised power divider with SIW and CSRR has been designed for C band applications. Half mode SIW structure reduces the size, loss and improves the performance, whereas CSRR exhibits band pass response. The power dividers response can be changed by changing CSRR dimensions. The proposed power divider exhibits pass band filter response and an equal power division at 6.8 GHz. The dimension of the power divider is 12mm × 9.8mm × 0.5mm.

articleTitle: Two element microstrip antenna array using square slot EBG structure for C-band applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper discusses the performance of two element microstrip antenna array (TMA) in the absence and presence of square slot 2D-Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG) structure. The antenna arrays have been designed using Mentor Graphics IE3D simulation software and measured results obtained using vector network analyzer. The antenna arrays have been fabricated using FR-4 glass epoxy substrate. The proposed antenna array operates in the C-band ranging from 4–8 GHz. The TMA designed at 6 GHz resonates at 5.445 GHz with a bandwidth of 197 MHz. With the EBG structure loaded in the ground plane of TMA, the antenna array shows enhanced performance in terms of bandwidth, mutual coupling, miniaturization, back lobe radiation and front to back ratio.

articleTitle: SEPIC converter based MPPT controller for SPV module under partial shading condition
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The increasing in the use of distributed generation with traditional power generation system leads to continuous evolution of power electronic interfacing system. This paper deals with some of the most crusial aspects of power electronic converter i.e. detection of fundamental frequency and its components for grid interfacing of the converter. The paper proposes SEPIC converter technology with Maximum power point tracking system so as to extract the maximum amount of power from solar cell by operating it at slope tending towards zero. The paper presents a detail description and validation of solar photovoltaic system under partial shading condition with multiple peak of P-V and I-V curves. MATLAB based modelling and simulation scheme was used, which solves the multiple peaks problem and track the global point.

articleTitle: Micro turbine starting and harmonic mitigation in distributed generation using active power filter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Micro turbine generators are often used these modern days as distributed energy resource which is connected to distribution system. The main reason using micro turbine generators operated with waste fuels suiting most of the industrial loads of small scale to medium due to advantages like compact size, high speed, good efficiency, less maintenance, low emissions. Permanent magnet turbo generators are required to couple with the micro turbine. The generated output power from turbo PM generator is of high frequency, so AC/DC/AC converter is been used to convert the output AC power of high frequency into the grid frequency for grid interconnection. A huge increase in the loss and temperature of high speed machine is been noticed especially due to the high frequency harmonic currents produced by the power conversion system. This paper presents a multifunctional three phase active power filter(APF) which is used as PWM inverter to start micro turbine and then it is used as active power filter to mitigate current harmonics produced by AC-DC converter. A Synchronous reference frame(SRF) theory based control strategy is implemented for both PWM inverter and active power filter. The complete system is modeled and simulated in Matlab/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a laboratory scale three-phase thyristor controlled reactor
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents design, implementation and analysis of a laboratory scale three-phase thyristor controlled reactor (TCR). The performance of the TCR is demonstrated through many case studies for different connections of the TCR branches. A detailed harmonic analysis is carried out to understand the harmonic behaviour of the setup. The fundamental reactance characteristics of the TCR is also obtained experimentally and compared with ideal characteristics. A simulation model is developed using ‘MATLAB’ to verify the oscilloscope captured-waveforms. This setup is found to be a good learning resource for introducing variable reactance nature of a TCR.

articleTitle: DC-DC converter topology with maximum power point tracking strategies for renewable energy systems — A survey
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper focuses on a survey of the renewable energy systems, which are reliable and they can play a vital role in power generation and they are gradually being accepted as important alternatives because these are freely available, environmental friendly over fossil fuels and they are considered as promising power generating sources due to their availability. The energy system depends on reliable power and the corresponding system cost which are the two main concerns of renewable energy resources under varying weather conditions. The renewable energy sources like Sun, Wind, Geothermal, Ocean and biomass are environmental friendly and sustainable. Out of these the Ocean and Geothermal are not cost effective because it is not feasible to transport from long distances. The renewable power generation systems are becoming popular in remote areas due to the significant rise in fuel cost and progression in renewable energy technologies. It is found that the progress effort which has non-linear characteristics in the renewable field is still required to achieve the system performance. This paper is to review the current state of effective DC-DC power electronic converters, different control strategies, an intelligent (Maximum Power Point Tracking) MPPT strategies and simulations likely for different renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: A survey on unique identity tag using RFID technology
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology is getting famous among identification technologies owing to its less cost, elegant weight, decreased the size and inexpensive maintenance. Due to the recognition of RFID in the area of manufacturing, retail and pharmaceuticals, it is now in contemplation for use in the various different field like pervasive processing, health care, agriculture, transport and security, license arenas. The RFID technology plays a significant role in the arenas of Governance. Smart Governance is about a technology to make better decision making. It helps in improving the democracy of the country and also it makes a better transformation to the public. The stakeholders of Smart governance are Government and the citizen. The main study of this article is to explore the various existing approach while addressing the prevention of the issues in Smart Governance have not been a uniform social development of the urban and rural population.

articleTitle: Artificial neural fuzzy inference system based implementation of SVPWM for current control of grid connected solar PV system
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, an ANFIS based control system is proposed to control the grid connected inverter and its performance. The aim of this paper is to introduce a non-linear control algorithm based on novel architecture. The ANN involved in the design is trained by collecting datas from the predesigned fuzzy controller. The paper also illustrates the comparative study of various algorithms used in the literature. The architecture of the proposed model is simulated with MATLAB Simulink model as it is globally accepted. Simulation results shows a better performance which when implemented in a real time monitoring system.

articleTitle: Sampling of bank stock using machine learning and Pearson measure
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper is to predict the main attributes of the dataset which relates to bank stocks. By this the performance of the system increases and hence uses less data to acquire the output. Finally, this output is compared with the actual output which is acquired by using all the data. Hence the main attributes are predicted by using Machine learning and Pearson measure.

articleTitle: VLSI architecture for IEEE single precision floating point moving average calculator
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Moving average is largely used in various image and signal processing applications. Direct calculation of moving average requires a large number of additions which depends upon the segment length. A moving average calculation method which calculates the moving average by updating the previous moving average output with the help of two subtractions regardless the segment length is widely used. This method can be implemented in fixed point arithmetic by using two subtractors and a divider. But, this method cannot be implemented for IEEE floating point arithmetic directly as floating point adder/subtractor have the latency more than one clock cycle. In this paper, a reformed moving average method for implementing it in the IEEE floating point format is proposed. A resource-optimized architecture of the proposed method is also given in the paper. The proposed architecture is synthesized in Xilinx FPGA XC4VLX100 (Virtex 4). It occupies 2785 slices and the maximum operating frequency is found to be 353.107 MHz.

Author Keywords: IEEE single precision floating point format

articleTitle: A note on rank correlation and semi-supervised machine learning based measure
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paperwork deals with similarity measure using Kendall's coefficient tau and spearman's coefficient rho. The results for the same ordinal values of two variables that are related and we are also going to describe a note of study in sample data that we got using the semi-supervised machine learning predication. We will use simple linear regression model technique to predict. Here we use Pearson correlation to calculate simple linear regression. Though this two coefficient (rank correlation) looks similar it has some differences which give major change as far as rank correlation results are concerned. And finally we will elaborate which one has more advantage and which is better to use and we will elaborate the note of study in data using simple linear regression model.

articleTitle: Estimation of position of electromechanical actuator valve using Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Until you measure, you cannot control. Keeping in mind the end goal to have better control, it is essential that the estimation be as accurate as could be expected. The need for enhanced and exact control gets highlighted in circumstances where the parameters of the specific system changes quickly in a brief length of time. One such circumstance is controlling the throttle valve of the electronic throttle body. A proper control structure for the throttle valve is necessary as the angle of opening determines the amount of air injected into the combustion chamber. It is very crucial to be in command of the amount of air entering as it directly affects the engine performance and emissions. Naturally, it follows that an error in measurement of the angle of opening of the throttle valve will have an impact on the crucial parameters of the powertrain frameworks of the vehicle, which is unacceptable. In this paper we have presented a Kalman filter based control algorithm for the electronic throttle body. It takes the values of the input voltage to the motor and the throttle position sensors and aims to minimize the error and quickly adjust the angle at the correct value. A comparison of the proposed algorithm and a conventional PID controller has also been included.

articleTitle: Study of spectral and temporal effects in the perception of noise degraded speech
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cochlear Implants (CI) are surgically installed biomedical gadgets that give hearing to significantly hard of hearing individuals by direct electrical incitement of the auditory nerve. It has been recognized that auditory simulation models in cochlear implants improve the perception of speech significantly. For music and hearing perception in noisy environments, phase cue plays a major role but it is not being conveyed by the present day auditory models. This paper describes the results of a study on the spectro-temporal effects on the perception of English phonemes comprising vowels and consonants. An auditory simulation model is developed to extract and process the spectral and temporal features using Hilbert algorithm. Six English phonemes are presented to normal hearing listeners under various signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and their speech intelligibility scores are computed.
