Significant improvement is achieved and hence this model should be helpful for enhancing the speech intelligibility of cochlear implant subjects.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of an islanded urban micro grid
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A micro grid is a small-scale power grid that can operate independently or in conjunction with the area's main electrical grid. Islanded micro grid may consist of both renewable as well as conventional energy resources. Power generation greatly depends on weather conditions. Supplying electrical energy in response to demand variations is a challenging task. An islanded urban ac micro grid is considered where the demand requirements are met by PV based active generators (AG), Micro gas turbines (MGT) and Diesel generators (DG).A portion of the total load is taken care of by Active Generators and the remaining part will be supplied by MGTs and DGs. Objective is the optimal load sharing between MGTs and DGs in the most economical way. The optimization problem is approached as a unit commitment problem based on day ahead PV generation and Load forecast. Basic simulations are performed in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Real time measurement of heart rate and it's variability
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents an Arduino based real time heart rate recording system. It extends the benefit of portability and helps in detecting arrhythmia. This serves as a boon to people who faces regular heart problems and need to be kept in watch. In addition to detection of heart rate, this research is concerned with analyzing the variability in heart rate. It makes this approach suitable to estimate any abnormal heart conditions, and mental stress. A real time non-invasive system that uses pulse oximetry sensor showing pulses to measure the heart rate has been developed. Thus recorded photoplethysmograph (PPG) signal of 10 healthy subjects from their finger tip, and investigated their heart rate and its variability to detect arrhythmia has been recorded. The designed system stores the data to be analyzed repetitively and made available for comparison. The hardware design utilizes arduino platform simplifying the low level circuitry issues. The software part involves algorithm based on statistical mathematical models. Computational efficacy of this algorithm receives real time data and is processed to detect any abnormality in health care management.

articleTitle: Nanotechnology Vis-à-Vis Computing: With special references to cloud computing, big data management — A techno managerial knowledge study
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Nanostructures, atoms and molecules are the key matters of nanotechnology. It is applicable in almost all the domain of applied science which includes physics, chemistry, biology, material science, computer science, bio technology and so on. There are huge requirement of nanotechnology in computing and information technology. Nanotechnology has wider scope in computing specially in core computing i.e. use of nano-materials rather silicon chip. Today the size of every kind of electronic devices becomes smaller and for this nanotechnology has played a vital role. The bulk or top-down technology is another important one where applications nanotechnology in computing and information technology taken place. The modern computing and information technology generation seeks more nanotechnology applications for smarter and smaller electronic gadgets. In recent past top down technology is core and very much important criteria for the nanotechnologist and information scientist and technologist are also putting efforts on creation of products by the use of this. In the field of Information Technology, Cloud computing is a kind of mechanism for software and hardware practices empowered by virtualization. The architecture of cloud basically uses less and minimum uses of computer, hardware as well as IT Delivery and in this case application of Nanotechnology are no doubt important and valuable. In recent past Nanotechnology has also created a new avenue for another IT technology i.e. Big Data. In this paper basics of Nanotechnology including its applications in computing and information technology etc have well illustrated. Cloud computing-Big Data Management and their current opportunities in connections with Nanotechnology has also well defined. The paper also prepared with the aspects of issues and challenges as well.

articleTitle: Investigation on DC-AC converter with reduced device count
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cascaded DC-AC multilevel converters incorporate a medium output voltage in view of an arrangement association of power switches which utilize low-voltage segment arrangements. This trademark permits one to accomplish amazing output voltages at the output and currents at the input and furthermore extraordinary accessibility due to their inborn part excess. Because of these elements, the cascaded DC-AC multilevel converter has perceived as a great option in the medium and high voltage converter showcase. In the present paper, a novel DC-AC multilevel inverter is proposed with less count of power electronic switches and power sources. Therefore, the overall economy and complication of the converter is decreased. To determine the voltage magnitudes a new algorithm is developed. Later comparison have been done between proposed topology and existing topologies. MATLAB/Simulink is used for simulating the circuit for performance verification. Finally, to validate the developed topology hardware model is developed.

articleTitle: Modeling based on frequency to oversee the condition of transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Although transformers are one of the most familiar parts of the power system they are even more complex to model. With modeling comes the question of accuracy. These days due to varied reasons, mainly short circuit faults, the transformer failures have increased excessively. For this reason and so as to predict the faults before their occurrence the modeling of transformers becomes imperative. This paper discusses the numerous reasons for transformer deterioration. Also it discusses the internal condition monitoring of the transformer.

articleTitle: Interleaved flyback converter for the RF-module with current slope-compensation and rise time controlled LDO for pulsed outputs
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Radio Frequency transmission and reception modules (RF modules) require a special power requirement where power is required only for short duration of time when they transmit or receive data, with high reliable power bursts which may last as small as 5us, which also require high currents. These design requirements of the RF power supply module (PSM) is achieved by incorporating interleaved flyback converter where the peak input current in the primary side of PSM is controlled by Slope Compensation current mode control along with fast control response, as required in RF modules and over power protection circuit is incorporated as high power is dissipated in very short duration of time. This paper covers extensive design procedure and hardware comprehension of RF module PSM which operates at a 100KHz switching frequency and the output power ranges from 8.05 W 80.5W having one output with high current output of 14A having 80% efficiency and power burst time can be varied between 5us-50us by controlling the gate pulses to the Low-Dropout Regulators (LDO) through external clock.

articleTitle: Impact of grid connected solar power on load frequency control in restructured power system
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents the traditional automatic generation control (AGC) strategy. For the simulation Gujarat power system has been divided in two areas. Each area consists of two Generating Companies (GENCOs) and two Distribution Companies (DISCOMs). For the visualization of power pool company (POOLCO) based contract and bilateral contract by distribution companies (DISCOMs) the DISCO participation matrix (DPM) has been used. Sudden load variation results in frequency deviations have been presented. Additionally, impact of grid connected solar power on frequency has been observed. Due to blinking nature of energy generated from solar the frequency deviation increases, which further add to the variation caused by load deviation. The two area power system has been simulated in MATLAB/Simulink environment. Finally, it has been strongly recommended the need of storage technology to regulate frequency deviations. From the literature review it has been realize that there is necessity of storage of particular amount of the power during such fluctuations, which can be fulfilled by Battery energy storage (BES).

articleTitle: A note on the evaluation of health care management metrics using source monitor tool
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This article evaluates the health care management metrics using the Tool Source Monitor. Our complexity assessment of LOC metrics pertains to Java language of various modules such as Health care management system, Patient-doctor interaction system and Hospital Management. At the end, we present the productivity metrics of health care such as LOC, number of methods, classes, statements, calls, average complexity, and maximum complexity.

articleTitle: Cloudinar hall — An extended study
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cloud storage is the most prominent technology which is quite scalable that provides various services in the internet based community. In order to leverage the means of computing in educational sector, this technology is widely used. The framework of today's educational environment is much more complex and it is quite similar and there is no peculiar effectiveness especially in training activities. Even though there is a good emergence of technology evolving within these generation, the educational sector does not implement much of its factors, in which the students are compelled to carry burdens which cost more than their original weight. With respect to student community scholarly persons and other literature activities which is held by means of the same procedure. In order to solve this issue and also to solve the lack of visualized effects in teaching perspective cloudinar halls promotes a good relationship between the tutor as well as the listener, by using a projector that can be paired with a tablet or smart phones of the learners, to access projector's data, using wireless technique. This is much related to the popular environment which promotes the quality of education as well as the quality of service in delivering data in a more effective manner in which the interaction between the teacher and the students will be bridged in a beneficial way.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of interline unified power quality conditioner (IUPQC) with PI and fuzzy controllers
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Todays power distribution system suffers with quality and continuity of the power. Interline Unified Power Quality Conditioner (IUPQC) is combo of Series and shunt connected second order devices for enhance the power quality(PQ) in distribution system. The paper compares efficiency of IUPQC with Fuzzy Logic (FL) and Proportional Integral (PI) Controller in PQ enhancement in two feeder utilization system. The proposed IUPQC provides compensation in Voltage disturbances like sag/swell and reduction in Total Harmonic distraction. The efficiency of the proposed configuration has been verified and compared with PI and FL Controllers configuration through simulation studies using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Design of a novel three phase multilevel inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents the new topology for three phase nine level inverter. The Capacitor Clamped H-Bridge (CCHB) three phase Multilevel Inverter (MI) is design in MATLAB and generates nine-level three phase ac output voltage according to suitable control (gate) signals. The number of semiconductor switches (IGBTs) and switching losses of power devices can be reduced in the proposed multilevel inverter. The operating principle of the proposed inverter and power quality parameter of the output like harmonics, RMS and power factor are discussed. Finally, the best results have obtained through proposed (CCHB) three phase multilevel inverter in MATLAB/SIMULINK platform. The switching sequences of IGBTs are generated using Sine Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) technique pluses with carrier displacing technique.

articleTitle: Harmonic compensation of nonlinear loads using current controlled, grid connected DG unit
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The rising use of nonlinear loads may increase power quality problems. The harmonic reduction strategy by using the current controlled method for active compensation for the nonlinear loads and distribution generation (DG) interfacing converters is proposed by this paper. The intended current controller owns two control streams to control independently fundamental current and harmonic DG current. The closed loop power control scheme to derive fundamental reference current instead of using phase locked loop (PLL) is proposed by this method. The error found while tracking power in DG unit is eliminated with the help of intended power control method and exact power control is obtained during harmonic compensation.

articleTitle: Optimal load shedding for radial distribution system using improved gravitational search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The most important perils for power system security are cascading failures and blackouts during contingency situations. In order to reduce the risk of cascaded outages and blackout, load shedding has been considered as a preventive scheme. This paper presents a novel application of the heuristic optimization algorithm, improved gravitational search algorithm (IGSA) to find an optimal load shedding strategy for radial distribution systems during an overload contingency. Overload contingency in the radial distribution systems without and with installed distributed generations (DGs) are the two cases considered in this paper. The proposed method has been tested on IEEE 33-bus radial distribution system. The feasibility of the proposed algorithm has been validated with results reported using Genetic Algorithm (GA) in terms of quality of the solution over realistic test systems considered.

articleTitle: Comparison of low dispersion and high nonlinear PCF with different lattices: Triangular, square and asymmetric
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, we put forward comparison between optical parameters of square symmetric lattice, triangular symmetric lattice and asymmetric lattice Photonic Crystal Fiber. Simulation using COMSOL Multiphysics illustrates that the designed fibers are characterized by low dispersion and very high non linearity which makes them suitable fibers for the realisation of super continuum generation at lower wavelengths with low input power requirements. Among the designed fibers, triangular lattice Photonic Crystal Fibers has very high non linearity of 2235 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> at 0.8μm wavelength. The structures found to have zero dispersion wavelengths closer to telecommunication window.

articleTitle: A novel transcutaneous energy transfer technique for biomedical implants
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Modern power electronics plays a very important role in biomedical applications. Transcutaneous energy transfer technique is generally used in power transfer to the biomedical implants. This paper proposes a new transcutaneous energy transfer system for biomedical implants like artificial heart, pacemakers etc. The proposed system uses modified push-pull converter on the primary side. The proposed circuit has less complexity and reduced number of switching devices compared to the existing systems. The proposed circuit is simulated using MATLAB/SIMULINK R2012b. The simulation result shows almost constant DC voltage can be achieved on the secondary side which can used for biomedical implants.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis on coupling of electrical machines
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In many real time heavy weight lifting applications such as cranes and elevators need more uplifting power with constant speed. To obtain these criteria, multiple machines working in motoring mode should be coupled in a single shaft. Multiple machines working in generating mode is coupled in a single line at many power plants for large generation. So for coupling of multiple electrical machines in motoring and generating mode modeling helps to analysis the performance of machine working and further research. This paper mock-up the electrical machines coupling by mathematical modeling. The simulation of modeling is performed by MATLAB/SIMULINK software platform. Therefore the different testing can be performed without any real time hardware expenditures.

articleTitle: Adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system for modeling of electronics devices: A review
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Device modeling is to design model, which acts precisely like real device by giving same characteristics. Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS)[1] is one of the example of computational intelligence which can be used for modeling of electronics devices like BJT, FET etc. ANFIS is helpful for mapping of input-output based on predetermined input output data pairs mostly in case of nonlinear function generation. In this paper study of various such devices, which are modeled using ANFIS, is shown. These models are then used in circuit simulation and also implemented in hardware i.e in FPGA. This modeling of devices enhances the speed of simulation, more reliability and also gives better time complexity.

articleTitle: Analyzing students academic performance using internal factors — A survey
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In recent years it is found that many organizations use Business Intelligence in most of sectors in order to gather, consolidate, analyze and provide access to data to provide better decision making by providing the right information to the right people at the right time. This paper presents a survey based on the concepts, technologies and tools used in Business Intelligence. A survey is also presented regarding the use of Business Intelligence in Education sector as contribution towards this sector is less when compared with various fields. This paper also aims in providing a survey on different kinds of techniques used for analyzing students' performance using the internal (Quantitative) factors. With this survey a solution is provided for analyzing students' performance using only the internal factors which is analyzed using the influencing ratios, constructed using the genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Broadband polarization insensitive and angle independent metamaterial absorber
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A novel metamaterial based electromagnetic absorber is presented. The structure of the absorber comprises of two split ring resonator, four square patches and a cross shaped patch printed over a dielectric substrate. The structure shows strong absorption bandwidth from 8.3 GHz to 16.58 GHz covering entire X-band and a part of Ku-band. The designed absorber has polarization insensitive behavior due to its four fold structural symmetry. Also the structure is insensitive to the wide angle of incidence. The designed absorber is compact, thin and can be used as a shield for EMI/EMC applications.

articleTitle: Mobile powered sub-group detection/formation using taste-based collaborative filtering technique
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Social networking sites such as Flickr, YouTube, Facebook, etc. contain huge amount of user contributed data for a variety of real-world events. We describe an unsupervised approach to the problem of automatically detecting subgroups of people holding similar tastes or either taste. Item or taste tags play an important role in detecting group or subgroup, if two or more persons share the same opinion on the item or taste, they tend to use similar content. We consider the latter to be an implicit attitude. In this paper, we have investigated the impact of implicit and explicit attitude in two genres of social media discussion data, more formal wikipedia discussions and a debate discussion forum that is much more informal. Experimental results strongly suggest that implicit attitude is an important complement for explicit attitudes (expressed via sentiment) and it can improve the sub-group detection performance independent of genre. Here, we have proposed taste-based group, which can enhance the quality of service.

articleTitle: Selective harmonic elimination for PWM AC/AC voltage converter using real coded genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper focuses on controlling the voltage of PWM AC/AC voltage converter and the use of Real Coded Genetic Algorithm to eliminate selected harmonics from output voltage. The fundamental component of the output voltage can be linearly controlled using the proposed method and harmonics can be completely eliminated up to a specified order. The Real Coded Genetic algorithm generates the best switching angles for a particular output voltage desired by the user with minimum total harmonic distortion (THD). THD values for different output voltages have been tabulated for 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> and 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic orders.

articleTitle: Sigma delta modulation and coupled inductor to reduce differential mode noise in boost converter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Conducted EMI in dc-dc converters necessitates use of filter along with them. This will add to the size and weight of the converter. In this paper, methods to reduce the size of the external filter are discussed. Here filter is made inherent part of the converter to reduce the size of the extra filter to be added. Coupled inductor's filtering performance is utilized here. Switching scheme employing sigma delta modulation also reduce EMI. In this paper boost converter with and without coupled inductor are analyzed using MATLAB as well as their hardware prototype are made and compared the differential mode noise performance. Hardware prototype is tested in open loop and closed loop employing sigma delta modulation. Coupled inductor and Sigma delta modulation in a single converter reduces EMI by 8 dBmV.

articleTitle: A performance measurement of three dimensional integrated solar PV system in Indian conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Energy crisis is increasing day by day which is driving us to the use of renewable eagerly sources available in form of SOLAR SYSTEM irradiation with far more predictability and universal availability. For last 40 years, the utilization of solar system irradiations in form of SOLAR THERMALS and SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC'S has crossed the nascent stage. SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC'S has already made headway in green power generation, however its large scale implementation is still struggling to find its acceptability due to high cost, huge land resources requirements and one dimensional (rooftop/horizontal) installation despite abundance availability in natural biosphere in all direction. In this paper, we are measuring the electrical power generation from solar PV panels in all eight directions on vertical surface.

articleTitle: A survey on secure object tracking using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: People have their valuable objects which are usually very small and prone to miss among the other unwanted objects. It is a frustrating situation that we come to know, that we have misplaced or lost the important objects like keys, phones or jewels in home and have no idea where they might be [2]. In our project, the useful available and unavailable objects are tracked using RF wireless communication [1]. Initially the RF transmitter and receiver can be connected with the help of raspberry pi board. The RF signal is used to transmit radio signal, the signal senses the object and once if the object has been missed, the RF signal information is received by the GPS receiver in order to measure the lost object correct position. Thus this project can make the indoor object tracking more efficient than the existing outdoor tracking technologies [1,4,7].

articleTitle: Green mobile communication and performance analysis of coordinated multi-point (CoMP) transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Energy consumption reduction is important factor in wireless communication and this problem should be properly addressed. Green cellular communication is nothing but environmental friendly approached for reduction of energy consumption. One of the green cellular communication methodology is implementation of the coordinated multi point (CoMP) transmission. In the traditional methodology, when a BS is switched off, the user in its coverage is provided service from the neighboring BS's by increasing their power, thus energy consumption of that particular BS's increases. But with the implementation with CoMP the neighboring BS's coordinate to serve the user. Main objective of the paper is to analyze how the implementation of coordinated multipoint (CoMP) transmission is better than the non — CoMP scenario by calculation of some parameters. In order to see how utilization of coordinated multipoint transmission could improve the user experience certain parameters like SINR (signal to noise interference ratio) and RATE have been plotted and calculated. SINR when implemented with CoMP have shown 75% improvement compared to that of Without CoMP and RATE has improved 3 times when implemented with CoMP Hence, these parameters have shown a significant improvement when implemented with coordinated multipoint transmission (CoMP) compared to that of Without CoMP transmission.

articleTitle: Matlab simulation on dual converter with separately excited DC motor as a load
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Dual converters are commonly used to operate the dc drives where the four-quadrant operation needed. Two back to back connected full controlled converters are called as dual converter. One of the converter works as a ac to dc converter and the other one works as a dc to ac converter. Thyristors are used for the switching operation which is controlled by the pulse generator. Open loop dual converter technique proposed in this paper. The Four quadrant operation of both the single-phase dual converter and the three-phase dual converter has explained using the Simulink model. All these implements can be used to control the speed or the torque using the open or closed loop system.

articleTitle: Coordinated control of series vectorial compensator and PSS for damping power system oscillations in series compensated AC systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents an application of the Coordinated-Control (COC) of power system stabilizers (PSSs) and FACTS controller, taking Series Vectorial Compensator (SVeC) as an example. The aim is to enhance the damping of low frequency oscillations for different values of the line compensations in multi machine networks. The SVeC can vary the reactance of a network through the variation of the duty cycle of AC link. Due to this reason a novel device is proposed and incorporated in the network. SVeC is a recently developed series FACTS device. The Western System Coordinating Council (W.S.C.C) is used for comparison purpose. The effectiveness of the proposed COC is checked by eigenvalue analysis and nonlinear — model simulations under normal load operation. The net results show that COC of SVeC and PSS can offer better damping characteristics at differnt levels in series compensated ac systems.

articleTitle: Multi-resonating antipodal vivaldi antenna for wireless communication domain design and modelling of multi-frequencies based antipodal Vivaldi antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel Motif Leaf Shaped antipodal Vivaldi antenna (MLSAVA), is presented for the applications in the wireless communication domain. The antenna is design on FR-4 substrate with a compact dimension of 38×29×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The leaf shaped antipodal Vivaldi antenna has successfully achieved dual resonating frequencies in the S-Band & C-Band respectively, which covers sub-bands coming under UWB Bands from 3.1 GHz to 10.6 GHz as prescribed by FCC. Beyond to this, the antenna is covering super UWB with the persistent to X-Bands.

articleTitle: Automated region masking of latent overlapped fingerprints
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Fingerprints have grown to be the most robust and efficient means of biometric identification. Latent fingerprints are commonly found at crime scenes. They are also of the overlapped kind making it harder for identification and thus the separation of overlapped fingerprints has been a conundrum to surpass. The usage of dedicated software has resulted in a manual approach to region masking of the two given overlapped fingerprints. The region masks are then further used to separate the fingerprints. This requires the user's physical concentration to acquire the separate region masks, which are found to be time-consuming. This paper proposes a novel algorithm that is fully automated in its approach to region masking the overlapped fingerprint image. The algorithm recognizes a unique approach of using blurring, erosion and dilation in order to attain the desired automated region masks. The experiments conducted visually demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault classification and detection of SVC integrated double circuit line
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper describes the fault classification and detection of SVC (Static VAR Compensator) integrated differential relay based double circuit transmission line applying Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) approach. The SVC is placed at mid-point of circuit-I of double transmission line. The other circuit (circuit-II) remains uncompensated. The differential relay based protection scheme is used for the analysis of fault detection and classification. The process starts by extracting current signals (A, B or C-phase) from both sending and receiving end of the transmission line synchronously and processes through DWT to obtain the spectral energy (SE) at both the end of the line. The Differential Spectral Energy (DSE) of each phase current signals are obtained by SE of current measured at sending end minus SE of current measured at receiving end. This DSE value is used to register the fault pattern.

articleTitle: Optimal load switching for low power islanded DC grids
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The rooftop solar panels are traditionally designed to be interfaced to the grid or to the battery and the MPPT algorithms are designed with the assumption that the no control on loads being available. But with the constant rise in the use of DC loads in the domestic setup, most of them being low power devices driven by a battery, DC microgrids is looking a promising oppurtunity to exlpore. In case of a DC microgrid implemented for a domestic setup and solar panels connected directly to loads we can have precise control over the loads. The paper proposes an algorithm for directly connected low power loads in a DC microgrid which will ensure that the load connected to the solar panels are always the ones that draw the maximum power from the panels for the given conditions.

articleTitle: Software metric LOC data analysis for symmetric key cryptographic technique
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: As IT industries are growing tremendously; it's difficult to keep track of the productivity, quality of the product, to ensure whether the developed application meets user requirements, customer satisfaction, cost, business operations and to analyze whether there are necessary resources to mitigate risk. In such situation, Metrics comes into picture, which is mainly used to measure the degree of given attribute possessed by the system, component or process, which helps in measuring the improvements and to gain efficiency. In this paper, we provide an overview of software metrics in quality and process and project metrics. We also provided a metric data analysis on symmetric key cryptographic technique to analyze LOC values.

articleTitle: Specifications-driven design of hexa-output flyback converter for transceiver applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this work, a low-power flyback converter with six output is designed and implemented with given specifications. In this proposed converter, an input voltage range of 60-75V and UC1846 IC is employed to provide gating pulses to main power switch with switching frequency of 100 kHz. In six outputs, three are continuous wave (dc) and remaining are pulsed output with two pulse repetition frequency (PRF) configurations is realized. Two PRF configurations with two different duty cycle are implemented. It has features of telecommand (TC) on and off, TeleMetry (TM) status, external synchronization signal circuits, EMI filter and over current protection (OCP) circuit is employed at input stage and control signals circuit for pulsed outputs is employed at the output stage. Proposed converter size is reduced by using Hybrid Micro Circuit technology. Experimental results and waveforms are provided to validate the design.

articleTitle: Design of low cost portable DAQ unit for Microbial fuel cells
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper we have developed a low cost portable voltage measurement and data logging system so as to incorporate it applications where voltage measurement is essential and in which the measured value must be saved. This has been designed using an Arduino Mega board incorporating additional modules such as Liquid Crystal Display to display the output, a storage module, a real time clock to provide the date and time of each measurement. The validation of the accuracy of this system has been implemented using a regulated power supply and a multimeter. It was statistically analyzed proving to result in minimal error. Further, it was incorporated to acquire data of a Microbial Fuel Cell system to study its characteristics.

articleTitle: Modeling and control of integrated photovoltaic module and converter systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The present work proposes a solar cell integrated Fractional Order Proportional, Integral and Derivative (FOPID) controller design for a boost converter. The conventional PID and FOPID controller parameters are tuned and simulated by MATLAB/Simulink. Simulation outcomes suggest that the output voltage of the FOPID controlled boost converter regulates the output properly for the low value of input voltage, generated by the PV cell. MATLAB/Simulink based simscape solar cell is arranged in an order to generate the input DC voltage of 24V and is integrated with a FOPID restricted boost converter to enhance the output voltage of 100V. The proposed FOPID control scheme is compared with the conventional PID controller and validated through extensive simulation studies.

articleTitle: Dielectric properties of epoxy resin composites with Al2O3 micro-fillers
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Epoxy resins are one of the most versatile thermoset dielectrics available for high voltage applications including, cable terminations, machine and transformer insulations etc. Addition of micro and nano fillers has become a common practice in past few decades. This paper illustrates an experimental study of surface discharge and breakdown on epoxy micro-composites. Specimen were prepared with various filler concentrations. Results show higher resistance of surface degradation in micro-composite for various voltage levels. Observations were done using optical microscopy and image analyses Dielectric breakdown strength was also increased on addition of fillers in appropriate amount but decreased above a certain concentration.

articleTitle: Development of gateway for industrial controllers
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Internet of Things(IoT) finds a wide application in the field of industry. Nowadays, the controllers and devices in the industrial fields are controlled by application installed in the Operating Systems(OS). The limitation of the existing system is that, the application used to monitor and control the systems cannot be used if the current OS is upgraded. Hence software maintenance is quite difficult. In this scenario, introduction of IoT will be a better solution. The development of gateway is a web server based module for remote monitoring of industrial controllers through a standard web browser in any computer connected to the network. The gateway is built around LPC1857 which is an ARM Cortex M3 based microcontroller. The system has multiple communication interfaces like RS485, CAN and Ethernet. It acquires data from the field and serve as a web page to any computer in the network.

articleTitle: Addition of new functionality ‘Glacial initiates’ to the GCM based on resistive sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper deals with the addition of new functionality named as Glacial Initiate to the genset control module (GCM). This Glacial Initiate is for protection of engine from friction and to stop the failure of turbocharger And also to increases the throughput and performance of the genset. New Glacial Initiate acts as a support for the genset which in turn increase the life of the genset. To one of the connectors of the controller on engine side the air temperature sensor is attached which sense the ambient temperature. For the black box testing we have used potentiometer as a variable temperature sensor. A MATLAB/Simulink model is designed for simulating the actual working of the new Glacial initiates functionality.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of ray tracing based rendering using OpenCL
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Rendering is a process of generating image either as 2D or 3D models. For rendering, OpenGL APIs are used to maintain cross platform compatibility. A simple rendering of computer graphics would be using OpenGL with the help of textures, lighting and shading. OpenCL is a framework for executing programs on a wide variety of platforms including CPU, GPUs, DSPs, ASICs and FPGAs. This paper evaluates OpenCL rendering performance on heterogeneous devices such as CPU, GPU and CPU+GPU. We've used LuxMark application which provides us with pre-compiled scenes for rendering using ray tracing techniques. LuxMark can optimally distribute workload(s) across multiple OpenCL devices connected to the host. From the experiment, we observed that CPU+GPU was faster than running on GPU and CPU alone by 50-70% and 60-600% respectively.

articleTitle: Dual core hexagonal photonic crystal fiber based polarization splitter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, a modified hexagonal micro-structured fiber as a dual core hexagonal photonic crystal fiber is proposed by removing two holes on each side of central air hole in vertical direction. By using finite element method and optimising the structural parameters a polarisation splitter is realised. Numerical results show that high birefringence in the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and shorter coupling length is obtained. A polarization splitter of 2.3mm long with -34.788dB extinction ratio is achieved at a wavelength of 1550 nm using optimized structure for a d/Λ of 0.7.

Author Keywords: Dual Core Hexagonal Photonic Crystal Fiber (DCHPCF)

articleTitle: Performance analysis of alamouti scheme in turbulence induced fading with pointing errors
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Free Space Optics (FSO) communication technology with Multi-input and Multi-output (MIMO) and subcarrier intensity modulation (SIM) has captivated interests in research due the diversity gain offered by MIMO. Atmospheric turbulence and pointing errors are the major challenges that affect the FSO system performance. In this work, the FSO based 2×1 Alamouti scheme employing SIM and Q-PSK is analyzed and compared without using Alamouti scheme with Gamma-Gamma (GG) fading channel considering pointing error effects. We derived the closed form expressions for symbol error rate (SER) with Alamouti scheme under the effect of different atmospheric turbulence and pointing errors using moment generating function (MGF). As a result, the proposed system could achieve a high signal-to-noise ratio(SNR) gain of 27 dB over the without Alamouti scheme under moderate and strong turbulence regime.

articleTitle: Tech trends in patient's health monitoring — A state of art
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Health care technology keeps on evolving. Monitoring vital signs is the basic task that is carried out to estimate the patient's health status. The possibility of estimating these parameters in an emergency vehicle even before reaching the hospital can help doctors to prepare themselves to give adequate care to the patient. Various methods are used for the same and this paper lists out some of the already existing methods along with some add-ons to improve the existing system.

articleTitle: Enlarged photodetection based on In2O3 nanowires/Si heterojunction with Al Schottky contact
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper brings an experimental fabrication of highly ordered perpendicular In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> Nanowires (In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> NWs) on Si substrate. The Glancing Angle Deposition Technique (GLAD) has been employed to synthesis In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> NWs on Si-substrate inside the e-beam evaporation chamber. articleTitle: Modeling of protection of converter systems against faults in a DFIG-based WECS
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, a crowbar model and converter's resumption/recovery control strategies are developed for a grid-connected DFIG to protect rotor-side converter systems against high currents during grid-faults. Further, the importance of crowbar resistance and its affect on the system stability are explained through various case studies.

articleTitle: Computer aided application to calculate and analysis of underground power cable ampacity
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents computer application to calculate underground cable ampacity. This is most important and significant task for construction site engineer is to calculate underground power cable ampacity based on site condition. The power cable ampacity changes as per site condition parameters. This application is based on Neher-McGrath ampacity calculation method. There are many tabular methods for cable ampacity calculation but by applying this computer aid application it will reduces error as well as cable ampacity as per site working condition.

articleTitle: Self-tuning approach for implementing a multidimensional recommendation system using PID
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The exponential growth in the online retail services and products has resulted in the generation of huge amounts of data. In an online retail portal, analysis of the data plays an important role in optimization of recommendation systems, which helps offer better user experience. As large amount of data is consistently updated in the databases of online retail portals, the data quantity keeps on increasing and it becomes more difficult to carry out analysis for the process of recommendation. Recommendation algorithms have been designed to take some input information and generate relevant recommendations. The performance of traditional recommendation systems and analysis techniques degrade while processing large data. New recommender system technologies are needed that can quickly produce high-quality recommendations, even for very large-scale problems. Here is a newly proposed algorithmic multidimensional approach that can be deployed to improve recommendation systems performance. PID is a closed loop, self-tuning algorithm which is predominantly implemented in mechatronics instruments where manual supervision is not feasible and it functions for correction of errors quantifiable in physical measures. If we were to map errors in physical dimensions to irrelevancy in computer systems it can be approximately stated to be higher the error, higher the irrelevancy. Also, the availability of multiple factor assessment in PID algorithms can be used to implement the multidimensional approach. As proposed and analyzed the implementation is expected to provide with faster as well as big data compliant analytics option.

articleTitle: Hysteretic controlled cascaded buck boost converter fed seven level inverter system
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cascaded back boost converter with seven level inverter (CBBCSLI) is a good choice between DC source and induction motor. This paper deals with comparison of closed loop controlled CBBSLI with and without hysteretic controllers. The aim of the present work is to maintain regulated voltage across the load. Simulink model developed for PI & HC based closed loop CBBSLI system and they are used for simulation studies. Matlab results show reduced current ripple by using HC. The hardware is engineered, tested and the results are compared with simulation results. The objective of this work is to improve the dynamic response of CBBCSLI using hysteretic controller.

articleTitle: Review on environmental pollution monitoring sensor using MEMS based non dispersive infrared spectroscopic technique
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Rapid industrialization and steady increase in the vehicular traffic resulted in production of various toxic and harmful gases which can lead to death. Environment quality management lies in continuous monitoring of environmental characteristics. Hence quick detection of such gases is needed. Gas sensors based on various technologies are available in the market. MEMS gas sensors are wide spread because of small size, reproducible output and low power consumption. The most common solid-state gas sensors are those made from semiconducting oxides. These sensors respond to a wide range of reducing gases such as hydrogen, have very poor selectivity, incapable of detecting inert gases such as CO2, they are contaminated or poisoning from chemicals, resulting in calibration errors, false measurements, and short service lifetimes. Comparing the solid-state gas sensors with spectroscopic sensors, spectroscopic sensors are advantages because of long life and specificity of detection. This paper gives detailed instrumental difference of normal spectrometer and MEMS based spectrometer.

articleTitle: Particle swarm optimization based DSTATCOM with reduced DC-link voltage for load compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper suggests a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) based Distribution Static Compensator (D-STATCOM) with non-stiff source for load balancing. A D-STATCOM configuration comprises of voltage Source Inverter (VSI) with spit DC capacitor source to introduce compensating currents in to the system. DC-link voltage of VSI is reduced by employing capacitors in series with the interfacing inductor and in shunt at Point of Common Coupling (PCC) for eliminating high switching frequency constituents of inverter. Switching of VSI is done using Hysteresis Pulse Width Modulation (HPWM) and reference currents required for this are generated using a positive sequence component extraction based Instantaneous Symmetrical Component Theory (ISCT) in non-stiff system. Taking into consideration the issues related with capacitor unbalanced in split DC voltage source inverter, proportional integral (PI) controller using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique is implemented to kept DC link voltage at its desired value. The performance analysis of proposed topology has been verified over traditional topology through an extensive MATLAB simulation.

Author Keywords: DC Link Voltage of voltage Source Inverter (VSI)

articleTitle: Device state change by monitoring heartbeat
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The proposed work is an attempt to design a wireless system that could help change the state of the device for ex., T.V sets, fan, coolers, tube lights, etc. i.e., to turn them off if they are in ON state or vice versa may be true depending upon the need for it or not. This is done by using monitoring heartbeat because when a person falls asleep heartbeat falls below 55 bpm which actually may differ for different ages of people. So basically Atmega microcontroller will be used to process the input and take required action on both the sides i.e., for calculating heartbeat pulses and triggering the relays for changing the state. The Xbee module will be used to setup the wireless communication between heartbeat and relay circuit. So it can be very useful tool to bring down the electricity losses that happen all the time.

articleTitle: Trigger generator for spark gap switching synchronisation
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A two electrode Trigatron spark gap switch is used as the main discharge switch and triggered by a reliable trigger generator. In this article, a novel synchronization of four parallel spark gap switches with an accuracy of 5-10 ns for high-frequency pulsed power application is discussed. The circuit uses a combination of one master spark gap and set of inductor and capacitors to generate a fast trigger pulse to synchronize four spark gaps and can be controlled via an IGBT switch. Two trigger generator circuits are discussed, based on pulse shaping network and pulse transformer; comprises a parallel combination of capacitor and inductor. A spark gap switch in triggered mode and the self-triggered mode is used to switch the energy from capacitive source to inductive load. Results show nanosecond level of accuracy in synchronization is reported in this paper along with simulations and analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of finite precision on the sigmoidal adaptive algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This article proposes to analyze the performance of the Sigmoidal adaptive algorithm (SA) when implemented using fixed point arithmetic. In particuler, it provides the performance curve and mismatch, comparing them in different lengths of words (number of bits). The method presented in this paper propose a Taylor series approximation of the gradient of the cost function of the SA algorithm for finite precision implementation. It is shown that the algorithm presents stability for different lengths of words and that the increase in the level of the steady-state mismatch is sensitive or influenced by the quantization of the variables involved in the calculations.

articleTitle: Fuzzy logic controller based dynamic performance analysis of AC drive with SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Induction motors are playing an imperative role in industries because of its downy controllability and jagged construction. It requires both ample field of speed and hasty response of torque irrespective to load modification for its application. The fuzzy logic controller has highly developed qualities amid the various speed control techniques. So the fuzzy logic controller has been implemented using SVPWM technique to control the speed, current and torque. The V/f method benefits to control speed. The space vector pulse width modulation technique which gives superior utilization of DC and reduction in harmonics is used in this scrutiny. The dynamic characteristic has been analyzed with fuzzy controller for induction motor. The Total Harmonics Distortion has been observed and plotted. The entire intend has been gadget and proved in MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Coordination of wind and PSP in India
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Wind Energy has become an astonishing power in the world. Nowadays people are realizing the importance of renewable energies, especially wind energy. Though we are extracting power from the wind, it is not extracted completely because of the load variation. Many wind turbines are made to turn off in case of high wind or low load. The solution for this problem is to coordinate wind plant with the hydro power plant especially pumped storage power plant. India has a good potential of wind energy remarkably in Tamilnadu. The wind farm is coordinated with the Pumped storage hydro power plant at Tehri in Uttarkhand, India. It is done with the help of PMU. The coordination is done with the help of MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Analysis of rain attenuation prediction models along earth-satellite path over Indian cities
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Rain plays a significant role in satellite communication link design as attenuation caused by rain is severe in Ku and Ka bands which degrade the performance of the system. This paper mainly focuses on predicting the attenuation caused by rain in five Indian zones through the ITUR model in the frequency range of 12–40 GHz. It further emphasizes on attenuation predicted through SAM (simple attenuation model) and Garcia-Lopez Model followed by a comparison between the various proposed models for rain prediction. The platform used for implementation is MATLAB.

articleTitle: Dual feed planar inverted-F antenna for MIMO application
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a dual port planar inverted F antenna. This antenna consists of a radiating patch with two isolated feed which are perpendicular to each other to save the space and cost. Slot has been introduced in the ground plane to achieve the isolation between the two ports. The height of the antenna is taken as 3mm which makes it suitable for the handheld devices. From the simulated results it can be seen that antenna covers the frequency band from 2.1 to 2.9 GHz for S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> > -10db. This antenna can be used for wireless LAN, long term evolution (LTE) and for worldwide interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX) frequency ranging from 2.5 to 2.7 GHz. It can also be used in mobile handsets as diversity and multiple-input-multiple-output(MIMO) antenna for different applications.

articleTitle: Congestion relief vehicular system
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper will undertake recollecting the driver security and comfort issues. Streets turned jamming areas wind up being extraordinarily dull and troubling, and in such a condition where one eye ought to be kept in the front and other on the surroundings close by general utilization of brakes as and when essential, if at all a system could be delivered that would guide the driver to know whether the vehicles/objects around are in a close-by edges or not, the driver would be quiet and the vehicle would be secured. Such a structure would not simply help the driver keep up honest to goodness partition with the vehicles around moreover evade sways and sudden braking.

articleTitle: Reduced capacitor stress one switched-inductor improved Z-source inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper proposes the novel topology of One switched-inductor (SL) improved Z-source inverter (ZSI) with reduced capacitor stress. The voltage boost and components used in the proposed topology are same as the SL-qZSI. Similar to SL-qZSI, this proposed inverter topology provides continuous input current, shares common ground with the supply, and suppresses the inrush current at start-up condition. In addition to that, the stress across the capacitor is less in the proposed topology. The proposed topology provides high voltage boost when compare to traditional ZSI with the addition of one extra inductor and three diodes. The analysis and the derivation of boost factor, switches voltage, diode voltages, and capacitor voltages of the proposed inverter are done and compared with the conventional ZSI, SL-ZSI, and SL-qZSI. The simulation results of the proposed topology are validated in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A frequency response approach to design Buck converter with over current protection
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents frequency response method for design of PI compensators with the voltage and current feedback loop. DC-DC converters have non-minimum phase so the output voltage cannot be directly regulated by the PI control. The average inductor current indirectly regulates the voltage so here the system dynamics are regulated. A detailed design procedure of voltage and current feedback loops are given with a step -by-step procedure of compensator design with stability, steady state accuracy and speed of response assessments on dual loop controller. Here the voltage and current loop dynamic response of a 100 watt Buck converter is reported using PI controller. The experimental result demonstrates that the model can correctly predict the dynamic and steady state behavior of a buck converter.

articleTitle: Implementing continuous and discontinuous space-vector pulse-width modulation using carrier based approach for diode-clamped multilevel DC-AC converters
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Various pulse-width modulation (PWM) strategies have been proposed for multi-level converters so far. These modulation strategies are typically either Space-vector based implemented or Carrier-based implemented. Carrier-based PWM offers less computational complexity and ease of operation in comparison with the classical space-vector PWM. Conventional space-vector PWM keeps dwell times of redundant states equal which reduces the Total harmonic distortion (THD) significantly. A general method to calculate the CM offset to implement the SVPWM using carrier-based approach is derived in this paper. Also, a generalized expression for the CM offset with varying weightage to the redundant switching states has been derived. Further, this modulation strategy has been extended to Discontinuous mode operation. Proposed approach has been simulated and the results are in agreement with that of Space-vector PWM.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised techniques based hyper-spectral image classification: A survey
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Now a days hyperspectral image processing is gaining attraction to the researchers because of its ability to detect and recognize the unique land cover types with high accuracy. The challenging task in hyperspectral image processing is classification. Image classification is complex process in hyperspectral imaging because of huge amount of data, limited labeled samples. Researchers have evolved many ways of hyperspectral image classification. Based on nature of training samples used in classification, Supervised, Unsupervised and Semi-supervised are methods of classification. This review paper presents various semi-supervised techniques used for hyperspectral image classification and research challenges are identified from comparison between them.

articleTitle: A review on power quality problems and its improvement techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In today's scenario Power Quality issues are turn into a serious matter for both electric power utilities and for power system engineers. Equipment used in power distribution are highly responsive to the disturbances which arises in the supply systems. Moreover, these equipment are connected together in supply system and in industries for the purpose of manufacturing. As a result the effect of any issue or problem on the equipment is very large. Usually some of the power system equipment generates disruptions, which consecutively affect the other equipment, and are supposed to develop the harmonics distortion. These distortion results in inefficient usage of power and are the major source of abrupt failure of the equipment. It affects the production process in industries, which causes financial loss, it reduces generation of power, also affects data processing activities such as in bank transaction process may lost, affects ticket booking process and generates many service sector problems in real time. The main purpose of this paper is to overlook the sources and determine the most common power quality problems occurring in the power system and study the methods available for improving these problems.

articleTitle: Solar lanes and floating solar PV: New possibilities for source of energy generation in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Renewable energy, is the vast source of potential for energy generation also have no negative impact on the environment. Solar Energy is one of the vital sources of renewable energy which is mainly utilized by photovoltaic effect, deliberated as an eco-friendly energy source because of its enormous potential and sustainability. Moreover, it reduces the dependency on conventional fuel. To utilize the solar energy, typically require huge land for establishing the solar PV plant which is almost inaccessible for an over populated country like Bangladesh. But there is a huge coastal area as well as 57 major rivers will be effective for establishing floating solar PV plant. Such wide-open spaces are also available as highways in Bangladesh. By converting these highways into solar lanes and floating solar PV plants will open new possibilities for source of energy generation in Bangladesh. A thoroughly numerable study for implementing solar lanes and floating solar PV power plant in Bangladesh is accomplished by counting allowances like accessible surface area, solar panel efficiency, position of the panels, basic design etc., which gives an overall image of total electrical energy generation. The electricity generation by using these thoughts are optimized by studying theoretical and simulation data. So, it is the veritable time of replace our conventional solar based infrastructure with the modern concepts i.e. Solar lanes and Floating solar PV plants.

articleTitle: A survey on IoT based road traffic surveillance and accident detection system (A smart way to handle traffic and concerned problems)
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Road Traffic is one of the most vital problem in our hastily developing world. This paper presents of study of different aspects and issues related to the problem. This paper emphasizes on using prominent technology - Internet of Things (IoT) for developing smart system to monitor various parameters related to road traffic and using it for effective solution. The survey of the existing systems and concerned techniques related to the problem area are discussed. Different issues like vehicle detection, occlusion detection, lane projectile detection, accident detection and related methods to solve these issues are explored. We propose our “IoT based traffic monitoring and accident detection system” consisting of Raspberry pi, and pi camera as hardware which will use live video as input and process it for gathering information about the live traffic. The system generates information regarding the traffic such as number of vehicles, emergency accident situations, and improper projectile of vehicle. The generated information can be used to handle and divert the live traffic as needed to avoid the problems related to road traffic.

articleTitle: Virtual machine placement strategies in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The prominent technology that drives the industry now-a-days is cloud computing. The growth of cloud computing has resulted in the setup of large number of data centers around the world. The data centers consume more power making it source for the carbon dioxide emission and a major contributor to greenhouse effect. This led to the deployment of virtualization. Infrastructure as a Service is one of the important services offered by cloud computing that allows virtualization and hardware to get virtualized by creating many instances of Virtual Machine (VM) on a single Physical Machine (PM) and helps in improving utilization of resources. VM consolidation includes method of choosing the more appropriate algorithm for migration of VM's and placement of VMs to the most suitable host. VM placement is a part of VM migration. The effective placement of VM is aimed to improve performance, resource utilization and reduce the energy consumption in data centers without SLA violation. This paper aims to focus on various VM placement schemes.

articleTitle: Cascaded multilevel inverter based electric spring for smart grid applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper proposes “Electric Spring” (ES) based on Single Phase three-level Cascaded H-Bridge Inverter to achieve effective demand side management for stabilizing smart grid fed by substantial intermittent renewable energy sources (RES). Considering the most attractive features of multilevel inverter (MLI), an effective structure of Electric Spring is proposed for suppressing voltage fluctuation in power distribution network arising due to RES and maintaining the critical load voltage. Also, the operation of ES in capacitive as well as inductive mode is discussed. Further, the paper describes droop control method for parallel operation of distributed electric spring for stabilization the power grid. An exclusive dynamic performance of the system using electric spring has been tested and demonstrated through detailed MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal reactive power dispatch problem solved by symbiotic organism search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper introduces a newly developed symbiotic organism search algorithm for deal with ORPD problem. The reactive power optimization problem is essential for suitable operation and regulation in power system network. It helps operators to control the voltage limits, to curtail the real power loss in transmission lines, enhances the strength of the electrical power system to withstand and counteract voltage collapse during load variations in an electrical power system. The symbiotic organism search algorithm is one of the assuring, latest developments in the tract of Meta heuristic algorithms. The texture - animated philosophy of symbiotic organism search algorithm resembles the interactive nature among organisms in feature. Organisms in the real cosmos infrequently live in isolation due to their dependence on other organisms for livelihood and longevity. This ORPD problem is formulated by generator output voltages (continuous variable), regulating transformers and switchable VAR devices (discrete variables). The proposed symbiotic organism search algorithm is realized for IEEE-14 bus and 30-bus systems. The improved result values are compared with Evolutionary programming, Differential evolutionary algorithm, dynamic particle swarm optimization, self-adaptive real coded genetic algorithm and modified Gaussian bare bones teaching learning based optimization.

articleTitle: A review on regenerative braking in electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Conventional vehicles running on fossil fuels is one of the cause for global pollution and as a result creating adverse effects on the environment. The electric vehicle is becoming a reality and seen as the promising solution, as it offers great advantage of regenerative braking by which driving range of the vehicle is increased by harvesting braking energy. Braking control systems such as Hybrid braking system and fully Electrified Regenerative braking system are normally replacing conventional frictional braking system to stop the electric vehicles. In such systems stability, precision control and soft transition from one state to another depends on control strategies. Classical controllers have limitations which are overcome by robust and intelligent controller. In this paper implementation methodology of Electrical motors, analysis and advancements of various controllers like Sliding mode controller, H2/H∞ controller, an Adaptive controller, Fuzzy logic controller in combination with various algorithm and control techniques, Artificial neural network control and Neuro-fuzzy with PID Controllers are discussed.

articleTitle: An overview on wireless body area networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Wireless body Area Network is the interconnection of multiple nodes that are located in or around the surface of the body which is capable of wireless communication. Wireless body Area Network involves various monitoring application environment, warfare, agriculture, military and health care. The sensor nodes are usually light weight, low cost, low power consuming intelligence devices which are capable of sensing, computing, communicating with each other wirelessly. This review gives a clear overview about the functions of WBAN. The main operation of protocols, transmitter and receiver of IEEE 802.15.6 are deeply examined and studied in this work. This survey paper provides quick summary about the sensor design, applications, power efficiency, energy conservation, communication protocols and security issues in WBAN.

articleTitle: Enhancement of available transfer capability using TCSC devices in deregulated power market
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electric power sector restructuring is a worldwide phenomenon and the format in which it is happening varies according to the economy and political setup of the country. The concept of deregulation introduces open access to the market and develops competition among the market participants. Thus, there is a need to develop a less dominant and transparent market to those participants. The technical challenges associated with the deregulated environment are transmission pricing, congestion management and available transfer capability. This paper concentrates on one of the technical challenges as Available Transfer Capability (ATC). This ATC value has to be updated instantly for making decisions on the system capacity reservations and transactions. The ATC, an essential indicator of the transmission system behaviour, has been formulated using linear sensitivity based AC Power Transfer Distribution Factor (ACPTDF) method in this work. This paper presents the significance of Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor (TCSC) device in ATC enhancement with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm employed to obtain the optimum value of TCSC device parameter. The results are presented for the sample 6-bus system and IEEE 30-bus system considered.

articleTitle: Impact of demand response contracts on short-term load forecasting in smart grid using SVR optimized by GA
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In a Smart Grid environment the performance measure of the grid is calculated by considering the fact that how accurately and precisely a load forecasting (LF) is done. A true Load Forecasting is vital to make a current grid smarter and more reliable when it comes to its performance. Demand Response (DR) contracts is a type of program in smart grid where the customer is free to select a type of contract which is given by the utility and is one of the growing factor which affects the load forecasting results in the Smart Grid, therefore in order to do a complete evaluation of smart grid performance and to accomplish an accurate load forecasting results the different types of contracts should also be studied. The purpose of this study is to accomplish two goals. The first one is to develop a suitable model which can incorporate various factors that can affect the load forecasting results. The subsequent goal is to identify the impact of the demand response contracts on the load forecasting results. In the proposed study, Support Vector Machine-Regression (SVR) is selected as the base methodology to perform a Short — Term Load Forecasting (STLF) under smart grid environment.

articleTitle: Autonomic and energy-aware resource allocation for efficient management of cloud data centre
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Server Virtualization is the key technology used in cloud data centers. In this technique, number of Virtual Machines (VM) can simultaneously run on the top of a single Physical Machine (PM) or host server. Each VM hosts guest operating system, middleware software and applications. There are various dimensions of resources available in PM such as CPU cores, memory, network bandwidth and storage space. As per the requirement of applications deployed, VM allocates resources from pool of resources available in a PM or host server. The placement of VMs into appropriate PM and as the need arises migrate them among other PMs by achieving application performance and saving energy are the key issues of this research paper. The performance of applications is improved by reducing frequency of live VM migrations among PMs and energy is saved by minimizing number of active servers in a data centre. The proposed approach presents algorithm for resource allocation in cloud data centre by considering various factors such as major resource requirement during initial setup of virtual machines, dynamic resource allocation at peak load on applications, performance of applications and power saving in a data centre. A data centre is simulated with heterogeneous servers by assigning load of randomly virtual machines containing CPU as well as memory intensive applications. The power consumption and VM placement failure rate are considered as parameters for analyzing the proposed algorithm. The experimental results of proposed algorithm for initial placement of VMs are compared with various algorithms such as first fit, best fit and random selection of PMs. In addition to the initial placement of VM in appropriate PM, the research issue of dynamic resource management in a data centre is also addressed.

articleTitle: Unit commitment using hybrid genetic algorithm with differential evolution
publicationTitle: 2017 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
